sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा भीष्ममासाद्य संयुगे। दुःखेन महताऽऽविष्टो विललाप सुदुःखितः॥
en: Thereafter king Duryodhana possessed with overwhelming grief, approached Bhishma, and O Sire, began to lament before him in great sorrow.

sa: उद्विग्नहृदयः सर्वा दिशः समवलोकयन्। न व्यतिष्ठत कस्मिंश्चिद् देशे वानरपुंगवः॥
en: That best of monkeys, of a disturbed mind, cast his looks around and could not stand (patiently) at any place.

sa: स ददर्श ततः सीतां पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम्। शोकभारैरिव न्यस्तां भारै वमिवाम्भसि॥
en: And thereupon he beheld Sītā, having a moon-like countenance, plunged in grief like to a laden boat sunk in water.

sa: यथा जयद्रथं पार्थो न हन्यादिति संयुगे। अक्षौहिण्योहिताः सर्वारक्षिष्यन्ति जयद्रथम्॥
en: As to how Partha might be prevented from slaying Jayadratha in battle. His several Akshauhinis will also protect the latter;

sa: प्राप्तमुद्योगकालं तु नावैषि हरिपुंगव। त्वं प्रमत्त इति व्यक्तं लक्ष्मणोऽयमिहागतः॥
en: O best of monkeys, finding you forgetful, Lakṣmaṇa has come here to inform you that the proper time has arrived.

sa: अपृच्छत्स तदा राजा मन्त्रिणस्तान्सुदुःखितः। उत्तङ्कस्यैव सान्निध्ये पितुः स्वर्गगति प्रति॥
en: Even in the presence of Uttanka, he sorrowfully asked his ministers the particulars of his father's going to heaven (death).

sa: कथं पुत्रं महात्मानं ज्येष्ठपुत्रमपश्यतः। शरीरं धारयिष्यन्ति प्राणा राज्ञो महात्मनः॥
en: How will the life of that high-souled king not seeing his magnanimous son, his eldest son, remain in this body?

sa: तदस्त्रं प्रेरितं तेन भीमसेनेन संयुगे। राक्षसस्य महामायां हत्वा राक्षसमार्दयत्॥
en: That weapon discharged by Bhimasena in battle, nullifying the mighty illusion of the Rakshasa, began to afflict the Rakshasa himself.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा तु राजा राजर्षेरिन्द्रद्युम्नस्य तत् तथा। मार्कण्डेयान्महाभागात् स्वर्गस्य प्रतिपादनम्॥ युधिष्ठिरो महाराज पप्रच्छ भरतर्षभ। मार्कण्डेयं तपोवृद्धं दीर्घायुषमकल्मषम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O great king, having heard from the highsouled Markandeya the account of the attainment of heaven by the royal sage Indradhyumna, that foremost of the Bharatas, Yudhishthira, again thus asked that sinless great ascetic and long-lived Markandeya.

sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवो महात्मनः। देशकालहितं वाक्यं भ्रातुरुत्तरमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing those words of his, the high-souled ten-necked one spoke to his brother a speech consonant to season and place,

sa: अहंकारात् प्रसूतानि पहाभूतानि पञ्च वै। पृथिवी वायुराकाशमायो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्॥
en: From Egoison were, indeed, born the five great elements. They are earth, air, ether, water and light numbering the fifth.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। भिक्षोः पञ्चशिखस्येह संवादं जनकस्य च॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old narrative of Panchashikha who was a Bhikshu in his practices and Janaka.

sa: मरीचिरत्र्यङ्गिरसौ पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः। वसिष्ठश्च महाभागः सदृशो वै स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: They were Marichi, Atri, Angiras, Pulastya, Pulaha, Kratu, and the highly blessed Vasistha who was equal to the Self-create himself.

sa: नादान्तस्य क्रियासिद्धिर्यथावदुपपद्यते। क्रिया तपश्च सत्यं च दमे सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: One who is not self-controlled never enjoys success in religious rites. Religious rites, penances, truth, all these depend upon selfcontrol.

sa: रन्तिदेवश्च सांकृत्यो वसिष्ठाय महात्मने। अप: प्रदाय शीतोष्णा नाकपृष्ठे महीयते॥
en: Sankriti's son Rantideva, having given only lukewarm water to the great Vasistha, ascended to heaven and received great honours there.

sa: अग्नेर्दुर्धर्षता ज्योतिस्ताप: पाकः प्रकाशनम्। शोको रागो लघुस्तैक्ष्ण्यं सततं चोर्ध्वभासिता॥
en: The properties of fire are irresistible energy, inflammability, heat, capacity to soften, light, sorrow, disease, speed, fury, and upward motion.

sa: तस्यां क्रीडन्त्यभिरतास्ते चैवाप्सरसां गणाः॥ शून्याकारं निराकाराः शुकं दृष्ट्वा विवाससः।
en: In these waters many beautiful Apsaras were playing. Seeing Shuka who was bodiless, those naked aerial beings felt no shame.

sa: मार्कण्डेयो हि भगवानेतदाख्यातवान् मम! स देवचरितानीह कथयामास मे सदा॥
en: I heard to this from the illustrious Markandeya. He used always to recite to me the acts of the gods.

sa: तस्य विक्रमणाच्चापि देवानां श्रीळवर्धत। दानवाश्च पराभूता दैतेयी चासुरी प्रजा॥
en: By his power the prosperity of the gods increased. The Danavas were defeated. The children of Diti were the Asuras.

sa: श्रीभगवानुवाच एकतश्च द्वितश्चैव त्रितश्चैव महर्षयः। इमं देशमनुप्राप्ता मम दर्शनलालसाः॥
en: The Holy One said The great Rishis, Ekata, Dvita, and Trita, came to this country from desire of seeing me.

sa: तत्र दुःखविमोक्षार्थं प्रयतेत विचक्षणः। सुखं ह्यनित्यं भूतानामिहलोके परत्र च।॥
en: A wiseman will try to rescue himself from sorrow. The happiness of living creatures is fragile both here and hereafter.

sa: स गत्वा द्विजशार्दूलो हिमवन्तं महागिरिम्। अभ्यगच्छन्नदी पुण्यां बाहुदां धर्मशालिनीम्॥
en: Arrived at the Himavat mountains that foremost of Brahmanas then reached the sacred river Vahuda whose waters produce great merit.

sa: अयं च सर्वभूतानां शुभाशुभगतिप्रदः। अयं च जन्ममरणे विदध्यात् सर्वजन्तुषु॥
en: You distribute all ends, happy or miserable, to all creatures. You ordain the birth and death for all created beings.

sa: वह्निं चापि सुसंदीप्तं मीनांश्चापि सुपीवरान्। स गौतमायातिथये न्यवेदयत काश्यपिः॥
en: Indeed, the son of Kashyapa offered for the acceptance of his guest Gautama a burning fire and certain large fishes.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। अष्टावक्रस्य संवादं दिशया सह भारत॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Ashtavakra and the lady known by the name of Disha.

sa: तत्र शक्रपुरोगाश्च लोकपालाः समागताः॥ देवा देवर्षयश्चैव तथा ब्रह्मर्षयोऽपि च।
en: There the regents of the world headed by Indra, as also the gods and the celestial and the regenerate Rishis.

sa: धर्मः सनातनश्च त्वामिहैवानुप्रवेक्ष्यति। अहं च विबुधाश्चैव त्वद्धिते निरताः सदा॥
en: Eternal virtue shall now live in you. Myself and all the gods shall always be busy with secking your well-being.

sa: ततः शीताम्बुसंयुक्ता दिव्यगन्धसमन्विता॥ पुष्पवृष्टिः शुभा तात पपात मम मूर्धनि।
en: Then, O sire, an auspicious shower of flowers dropped upon my head, carrying celestial fragrance and bedewed with cold water.

sa: अचेतना चैव मता प्रकृतिश्चापि पार्थिव। एतेनाधिष्ठिता चैव सृजते संहरत्यपि॥
en: Nature, O king, is inanimate and unintelligent. When presided over by Purusha (Soul) then only can she create and destroy.

sa: नापरीक्षितचारित्रे विद्या देया कथंचन। यथा हि कनकं शुद्धं तापच्छेदनिकर्षणैः॥
en: As pure gold is tested by heat, cutting, and rubbing, similarly disciples should be tested by their birth and accomplishments.

sa: इमे मां कृमयोऽदन्ति येषामुद्धरणाय वै। नास्ति शक्तिरपाणित्वात् पश्यावस्थामिमां मम॥
en: These worms are biting me. For want of hands I cannot drive them off. Look at this my miserable condition.

sa: ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य कन्यास्तास्तमृषि तदा॥ निश्चक्रमुर्गृहात् तस्मात् सा वृद्धार्थं व्यतिष्ठत।
en: Thus addressed, all those damsels went round the Rishi and then left the chamber, only that aged lady remaining there.

sa: सत्यशौचार्जवत्यागैर्वर्चसा विक्रमेण च। क्षान्त्या धृत्या च बुद्ध्या च मनसा तपसैव च॥ भावान् सर्वानुपावृत्तान् समीक्ष्य विषयात्मकान्। शान्तिमिच्छन्नदीनात्मा संयच्छेदिन्द्रियाणि च॥
en: Examining all earthly things that meet him, by the help of truth, purity, candour, a spirit of। renunciation, enlightenment, courage, forgiveness, fortitude, intelligence, reflection, and austerities, and desirous of securing tranquillity, a person of great soul should restrain his senses.

sa: मनोः प्रजापते राजनिक्ष्वाकुरभवत् सुतः। तस्य पुत्रशतं जज्ञे नृपतेः सूर्यवर्चसः॥
en: The Prajapati Manu had a son, O king, named Ikshvaku. That king, illustrious as the Sun, begat a hundred sons.

sa: दशमस्तस्य पुत्रस्तु दशाश्वो नाम भारत। माहिष्मत्यामभूद् राजा धर्मात्मा सत्यविक्रमः॥
en: His tenth son, O Bharata, was named Dashashva, and this virtuous prince of infallible prowess became the king of Mahismati.

sa: मदिराश्वस्य पुत्रस्तु द्युतिमान् नाम पार्थिवः। महाभागो महातेजा महासत्त्वो महाबलः॥
en: Madirashva's son was the king named Dyutimat who was ended with great good fortune and power and strength and energy.

sa: नकुल उवाच धनुः प्रहरणं श्रेष्ठमतीवात्र पितामह। मतस्तु मम धर्मज्ञ खड्ग एव सुसंशितः॥ विशीर्णे कार्मुके राजन् प्रक्षीणेषु च वाजिषु। खड्ड्रेन शक्यते युद्धे साध्वात्मा परिरक्षितुम्॥
en: Nakula said-The bow, O grand-father, known as the foremost of weapons in this world. I, however, prefer the sword, since when the bow, O king, is cut off or broken, when horses are dead or weakened, a good warrior, well-trained in the sword, can protect himself by means of his sword.

sa: हाहाभूतं जगत् सर्वमुपलक्ष्य तदा प्रभुः। पितामहो महादेवं दर्शयन् प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Exclamation of 'Oh' and 'Alas' arose throughout the universe. Marking this, the before powerful Grandfather, appearing Mahadeva, addressed him thus.

sa: आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः। आत्मैव ह्यात्मन: साक्षी कृतस्याप्यकृतस्य च।॥
en: One's own self is his friend and his enemy too, as also the witness of one's good and evil deeds.

sa: आपश्चैवान्तरिक्षं च पृथिवी वायुपावको। नासीद्धि परमं तेभ्यो भूतेभ्यो मुक्तसंशयम्॥
en: Water, Ether, Earth, Air, and Fire,—these are those five principal elements. Forsooth, there is nothing higher or superior to these.

sa: असदुच्चैरपि प्रोक्तः शब्दः समुपशाम्यति। दीप्यते त्वेव लोकेषु शनैरपि सुभाषितम्॥
en: Evil words, uttered with what strength of voice, die out. Good words, uttered, however softly, shine forth in the world.

sa: मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम। त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः सम्प्रकीर्तितः॥
en: 0 best of Bharata's son, listen to my opinion about Tyaga, for powerful of men, Tyaga is of three kinds.

sa: ततः प्रहस्य बीभत्सुः कौन्तेयः श्वेतवाहनः। दिव्यमस्त्रं प्रकुर्वाणः प्रत्यायाद् रथसत्तमः॥
en: Then smiling, the foremost of car-warriors Bibhatsu, the son of Kunti, having white, steeds, advanced (towards them) displaying celestials weapons.

sa: शून्यं दृष्ट्वा जगत् कृत्स्नं मानसानात्मनः समान् ततो मरीचिप्रमुखान् महर्षीनसृजन्नव॥
en: Seeing the universe entirely blank he created after him and from his mind the nine great ascetics Marichi and others.

sa: ये त्वया बलदर्पाभ्यामाविष्टेन वनेचराः। ऋषयो हिंसिताः पूर्वं देवाश्चाप्यवमानिताः॥ राजर्षयश्च निहता रुदत्यश्च हृताः स्त्रियः। तदिदं समनुप्राप्तं फलं तस्यानयस्य ते॥
en: Elated with power and pride, you who formerly killed many Rishis living in the forests, insulted the gods, slew many royal sages and carried off weeping damsels, are about to be visited with retributive justice for your those vicious deeds.

sa: तपश्चचार विपुलं तस्य प्रीतो वृषध्वजः। बलिं स्वयं प्रत्यगृह्णात् प्रीयणाणस्त्रिलोचनः॥
en: He engaged in great austerity and Shiva was pleased with him. Being pleased the three-eyed deity himself brought his offerings.

sa: एवंविधं हि कः कुर्यात् त्वदन्यः पुरुषाधमः। गतसत्त्वमिव ज्ञात्वा कर्तारमशुभस्य तम्॥ सम्प्रेक्ष्य भरतश्रेष्ठः :: कृपां चक्रे नराधिपः। धर्मे ते वर्धतां बुद्धिर्मा चाधर्मे मनः कृथाः॥
en: What other vile man, except you, would think of doing this again?” Knowing that he had lost heart and looking at that perpetrator of evil deed, the foremost of Bharatas and king of men showed mercy (saying), "May your heart grow in virtue, never think of doing any such impious deed.

sa: तौ विहायसमाक्रान्तौ दृष्ट्वा शाकुनिकस्तदा। अन्वधावदनिर्विष्णो येन येन स्म गच्छतः॥
en: The fowler seeing them fly up in the air without losing his senses followed them in the direction they took.

sa: प्रतिगृह्णाम्यहं राजन् स्नुषां दुहितरं तव। युक्तश्चावां हि सम्बन्धो मत्स्यभारतयोरपि॥
en: Oking, I shall accept your daughter as my daughter-in-law. Such an alliance between the Matsya's and Bharatas is indeed proper..

sa: किंचित्काले मनुष्येन्द्र सूतानामनुगा वयम्। मृगयित्वा यथान्यायं वेदितार्थाः स्म तत्त्वतः॥
en: O king of men, for sometime we pursued their charioteers; and making due enquiries we have got at the truth.

sa: क्रोशतो धृतराष्ट्रस्य बद्ध्वा योत्स्यामहे रिपून्। तेषां पापमभिप्रायं पापानां दुष्टचेतसाम्॥
en: In the face of the ravings of Dhritarashtra, and then fight the enemies>” This wicked intention of those wicked-souled wretches,

sa: एवं बहुविधं राजन् विलप्य करुणं पृथा। अवासृजत मञ्जूषामश्वनद्यास्तदा जले॥
en: Having, O king, thus wept long and bitterly, Pritha then consigned the basket to the waters of the river Ashva.

sa: पुरायमस्मान् गृह्णाति क्षिप्रकारी जनार्दनः। सहितो धृतराष्ट्रेण राज्ञा शान्तनवेन च॥
en: "Janardana, who does everything speedily, wants to capture us first in consultation with Dhritarashtra and the royal son of Shantanu.

sa: पितामहस्तु प्रीतात्मा ददौ वैश्रवणस्य ह। अमरत्वं धनेशत्वं लोकपालत्वमेव च॥
en: (However) pleased, the grand-father conferred on Vaishravana immortality, the sovereignty of all wealth and guardianship of one of the quarters.

sa: अप्रशस्तानि कार्याणि यो मोहादनुतिष्ठति। स तेषां विपरिभ्रंशाद् भ्रंश्यते जीवितादपि।॥
en: He who does uncommendable acts out of ignorance loses even his life, owing to the unexpected consequences of his acts.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पाञ्चाल्यः सात्यकिश्च महारथः। उत्तमौजा युधामन्युः सत्यधर्मा च सौमकिः॥
en: And Dhrishtadyumna, and the princes of Panchala and the great car-warriors Satyaki, Uttamanjus, Yudhamanyu and the virtuous prince of Somakas,

sa: पञ्चैव पूजयँल्लोके यशः प्राप्नोति केवलम्। देवान् पितॄन् मनुष्यांश्च भिक्षूनतिथिपञ्चमान्॥
en: By worshipping these five viz., the gods, the ancestors, men, beggars and guest a man obtains renown in this world.

sa: गजं तु सगजारोहं पदातींश्च चतुर्दश। जघान गदया भीमः सैन्धवध्वजिनीमुखे॥
en: But he slew, with mace, an elephant with its driver and fourteen foot-soldiers fighting in front of a Jayadratha's chariot.

sa: भीष्मः प्रस्थाप्य राजानं गोधनं तदनन्तरम्। सेनामुख्यान् व्यवस्थाप्य व्यूहितुं सम्प्रचक्रमे॥
en: Having sent away the king and thereafter the precious kine Bhishma addressed himself for arranging his troops in battle array.

sa: नासूयको न चापीर्नाभिमानी न मत्सरी। भविष्यति जनस्तत्र स्वयं धर्ममनुव्रतः॥
en: The people of the place where Yudhishthira lives envious, malicious, vain or proud but they always perform their respective duties.

sa: ततस्तेषु निकृत्तेषु विज्वरो मघवानथ। जगाम त्रिदिवं हृष्टस्तक्षऽपि स्वगृहान् ययौ॥
en: They having come out, Indra became tranquilized and went to heaven and the wood cutter too, well pleased, went home.

sa: ततस्त्रयोदशे वर्षे निवृत्ते पञ्च पाण्डवाः। उपप्लव्यं विराटस्य समपद्यन्त सर्वशः॥
en: Thus after the expiration of the thirteenth year, the five Pandavas took up their quarters in Virata's town called Upaplavya.

sa: इति मत्वाब्रवीद् धर्मं परमेष्ठी प्रजापतिः। वरुणाय प्रयच्छतान् बद्ध्वा दैतेयदानवान्॥
en: Thus thinking Paramesthi, the lord of all creatures, said to Dharma-"Binding these Daityas and Danavas make them over to Varuna."

sa: सोऽभ्ययात् कृतवर्माणं धृतराष्ट्रसुतो नृपः। कृतवर्मा ददौ तस्य सेनामक्षौहिणी तदा॥
en: The son of Dhritarashtra, himself a king, then went to Kritavarma and Kritavarma gave him an army counting an Akshauhini.

sa: बाधितो बन्धुभिः सार्धं बलाद् बलवता विभो। स कर्णमभ्युदीक्ष्याथ दुर्योधनमभाषत॥
en: O King of the powerful, being forcibly defeated along with his relatives, he, looking askance at Karna, said to Duryodhana.

sa: माल्यगन्धानलङ्कारान् वस्त्राणि विविधानि च। एतान्येवाभिजानाति यतो जाता हि भामिनी॥
en: Since her very birth the handsome lady has only been accustomed to garlands, perfumes, ornaments and diverse kinds of robes.

sa: धर्मार्थावभिसंत्यज्य संरम्भं योऽनुमन्यते। हसन्ति व्यसने तस्य दुर्लदो न चिरादिव॥
en: He who inclines towards wrath abandoning virtue and worldly profit, is soon rejoiced over by wicked men in his troubles.

sa: तथैव रथमास्थाय कृतवर्मा महारथः। वृष्णीनां सम्मतो वीरो हार्दिक्यः समदृश्यत॥
en: He also the great car-warrior Kritavarman, the son of Hridika, the respected hero of the Vrishnis seated on the chariot.

sa: ततस्ते पृथिवीपालाः प्रययुः सहसैनिकाः। भीष्मं सेनापतिं कृत्वा संहृष्टाः कालचोदिताः॥
en: Then did those rulers of the earth along with their commander. They looked cheerful as if urged by death himself.

sa: अथैनं पञ्चभिः पश्चात् प्रत्यविध्यत् स्तनान्तरे। सोऽपयातो रणं हित्वा पार्थबाणप्रपीडितः॥
en: He then wounded him on his breast with five arrows. Assailed by the arrows of Partha, he left the battle-field.

sa: अनाहूतः प्रविशति अपृष्टो बहु भाषते। अविश्वस्त विश्वसिति मूढचेता नराधमः॥
en: That fool the worst of men who enters unasked, speaks much unsolicited and has; confidence in those that are untrust-worthy.

sa: गतेषु वानरेन्द्रेषु गोपुच्छर्केषु तेषु च।॥ सुग्रीवसहितो रामः किष्किन्धां पुनरागमत्।
en: Those foremost of monkeys, the apes with tails like cows and the bears having departed, Rama reentered Kishkindha with Sugriva.

sa: ततः सुशर्मा त्रैगर्तः सह भ्रात्रा यवीयसा। अभ्यद्रवन्मत्स्यराजं रथवातेन सर्वशः॥
en: Then Susharma, the king of Trigartas, with his younger brother and surrounded by his cars, encountered the king of Matsya.

sa: यं यमेषोऽतिसंक्रुद्धः संग्रामे निपतिष्यति। वृक्षं गरुत्मान् वेगेन विनिहत्य तमेष्यति॥
en: On whom he will fall enraged in battle he will over-throw him like a tree by the velocity of Garuda.

sa: पातिता भीमसेनेन विराटस्य समीपतः। पत्तयो निहतास्तेषां गदां गृह्य महात्मना॥
en: Their infantry was slain by the high-souled (Bhima with mace in hand): Beholding such a fight Susharma, irrepressible in battle,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमाश्वासितो राजा मार्कण्डेयेन धीमता। त्यक्त्वा दुःखमदीनात्मा पुनरप्येनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus consoled by the intelligent Markandeya, the large-hearted king giving up his sorrow again spoke to Markandeya.

sa: स मोहमगमद् राजा प्रहारवरपीडितः॥ तस्मिन् गृहीते विरथे त्रिगर्तानां महारथे।
en: Assailed by the stroke the king lost consciousness. The mighty car-warrior, the king of Trigartas, deprived of car, being scized,

sa: यस्य बाहुबलं सर्वे पाण्डवाः समुपासते अर्जुनं तमयाहाय नकुलं जीवमिच्छसि॥
en: Why do you, forsaking Arjuna the strength of whose arms is worshipped by all the Pandavas, wish Nakula to revive?

sa: अद्य दुर्योधनस्याहं शल्यं हृदि चिरस्थितम्। समूलमुद्धरिष्यामि बीभत्सुं पातयन् रथात्॥
en: I shall eradicate today the dart from Duryodhana's heart existing for a long time by dislodging Bibhatsu from his car.

sa: एतच्चान्यच्च विविधं श्रुत्वा गालवभाषितम्। उशीनरः प्रतिवचो ददौ तस्य नराधिपः॥
en: Having heard all this and many other things said by Galava the ruler of men Ushinara gave him this answer.

sa: विष्णोः सहायानृक्षीषु वानरीषु च सर्वशः। जनयध्वं सुतान् वीरान् कामरूपबलान्वितान्॥
en: You all beget on monkeys and bears heroic and powerful sons capable of assuring forms at will to help Vishnu."

sa: आचार्यस्यैष पुत्रो वै अश्वत्थामा महारथः॥ सदा ममैष मान्यस्तु सर्वशस्त्रभृतामपि।
en: Is the preceptor's son, the mighty carwarrior Ashvathama, who is always worthy of my respect as well as other heroes.

sa: ततस्तद्वचनान्मत्स्यो दूतान् राजा समादिशत्।।१६ आचक्षध्वं पुरं गत्वा संग्रामविजयं मम।
en: At his words the king of Matsya's dispatched his emissaries, saying: “Going to my city do you announce my victory.

sa: स गत्वा कुरुसेनायाः समीपं हयकोविदः। पुनरावर्तयामास तान् हयान् वातरंहसः॥
en: Well-versed in the management of horses, Uttara, having neared the Kuru army, turned back his horses, fleet as the wind.

sa: शयानं शयने तत्र सूतपुत्रः परामृशत्। जाज्वल्यमानं कोपेन कृष्णाधर्षणजेन ह॥
en: Suta's son approached him who was lying on a bed, burning in anger begotten of the insult (offered to Krishna).

sa: गत्वा सुमहदध्वानमादित्यस्य प्रभां ततः। दृष्टवन्तः स्म तत्रैव भवनं दिव्यमन्तरा॥
en: Having traversed a great way through it, we saw the splendour of the sun and a beautiful palace within it.

sa: नियमेन परेणाहमुपस्थाये द्विजोत्तमम्। यथा त्वया नरेन्द्रेदं भाषितं ब्राह्मणं प्रति॥
en: Agreeably to your instructions with regard to this Brahmana, I will serve him with great regularity, O king of kings."

sa: न श्रद्दधाति कल्याणं परेभ्योऽप्यात्मशङ्कितः। निराकरोति मित्राणि यो वै सोऽधमपूरुषः॥।
en: He, who does not appreciates benefits coming from others and who drives away all his friends, is an inferior man.

sa: ततः किरीटी तस्यानुप्रविवेश महामनाः। पश्चाच्चैव स कृष्णस्य प्रह्वोऽतिष्ठत् कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: Then did enter the large-minded one, wearing a crown and stood with the hands clasped near the foot of Krishna.

sa: अक्षौहिण्यस्तु सप्तैव पाण्डवानामभूद् बलम्। अहौहिण्यो दशैका च कौरवाणामभूद् बलम्॥
en: The army of the Pandavas consisted of seven Akshauhini, while that of the Kauravas consisted of ten and one Akshauhini.

sa: अस्मद्धितं वाक्यमिदं भीष्मः शान्तनवोऽब्रवीत्। पाण्डवानां हितं चैव सर्वस्य जगतस्तथा॥
en: What Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, has said is calculated to promote sur interests and those of the entire world.

sa: सहस्रशिरसः केचित् केचित् पञ्चशताननाः। शतशीर्षास्तथा केचित् केचित् त्रिशिरसोऽपि च॥
en: Some of them are thousand headed, some have five hundred faces, some, again, have a hundred heads and some three.

sa: हित्वा तान् परमेष्वासान् पाण्डवानमितौजसः। आहितं भारतैश्वर्यं त्वया दुर्योधने महत्॥
en: Having abandoned those mighty bowmen, the Pandavas of unlimited prowess, you have, O Bharata, entrusted a great lordship on Duryodhana.

sa: सावित्र्युवाच सतां सदा शाश्वतधर्मवृत्तिः सन्तो न सीदन्ति न च व्यथन्ति। सतां सद्धि फलंः सङ्गमोऽस्ति सद्भयो भयं नानुवर्तन्ति सन्तः॥
en: Savitri said : The pious are ever unceasingly devoted to religion. They do neither fecl lassitude nor affliction. The intercourse of the pious with the virtuous is (ever) productive of good. And the righteous apprehend no fear from the virtuous.

sa: पुत्रेष्वाशासते नित्यं पितरो दैवतानि च। दानमध्ययनं यज्ञं प्रजानां परिपालनम्॥
en: The parents, and even the gods always expect liberality, study, sacrificial rites and the protection of subjects, of their sons.

sa: कांश्चिदर्थान् नरः प्राज्ञोलघुमूलान् महाफलान्। क्षिप्रमारभते कर्तुं न विघ्नयति तादृशान्॥
en: A wise man dose not wait, but quickly commences doing such acts, as involve little labour but produce great results.

sa: प्रस्थाप्य दूतानन्यत्र द्वारकां पुरुषर्षभः। स्वयं जगाम कौरव्यः कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Having sent messengers elsewhere, the best among men, Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti, of race Kuru himself, went to Dwraka.

sa: गच्छ लक्ष्मण जानीहि किष्किन्धायां कपीश्वरम्। प्रमत्तं चाम्यधर्मेषु कृतघ्नं स्वार्थपण्डितम्॥
en: "O Lakshmana, do you repair to Kishkindha and there seek out the ungrateful, self-seeking and licentious lord of the monkeys.

sa: ससंहाराणि सर्वाणि दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि मारिष। धनुर्वेदश्च कात्र्येन यस्मिन् नित्यं प्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: All the celestials weapons with the means of their withdrawal, and the entire science of archery always reside in him.

sa: शुशुभे वदनं तस्या रुदत्याः सुचिरं तदा। मेघलेखाविनिर्मुक्तं दिवीव शशिमण्डलम्॥
en: On her having wept so long her countenance appeared like the lunar disc in the sky freed from the clouds.

sa: एतस्य हि पिता नागश्चिकुरो नाम मातले। नचिराद् वैनतेयेन पञ्चत्वमुपपादितः॥
en: His father is the Naga named Chikura, O Matali and quite recently he was killed by the son of Vinata.

sa: विक्रमाधिगता ह्याः क्षत्रधर्मेण जीवतः। मनो मनुष्यस्य सदा प्रीणन्ति पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: Objects gained by the exercise of prowess always please the heart of a man following the duties of a Kshatriya.

sa: यावन्ति वाहनान्यस्य यावन्तः पुरुषाश्च ते। ततोऽष्टगुणमप्यस्मै भोज्यं दास्याम्यहं सदा॥
en: I shall present to him eight times the eatables that all his attendants and animals in the army may consume.

sa: तस्मात् कर्मैव कर्तव्यमिति होवाच नारदः। एतद्धि सर्वमाचष्ट वृष्णिचक्रस्य वेदवित्॥
en: Therefore is war their duty. This what Narada conversant with the Vedas has said to the race of the Vrishnis.

sa: नगरादपि याः काश्चिद् गमिष्यन्ति जनार्दनम्। द्रष्टुं कन्याश्च कल्याणयस्ताश्च यास्यन्त्यनावृताः॥
en: The beautiful girls, that will go out from this ten to see Janardana, will go with out their veils drawn.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा वरदा देवी युधिष्ठिरमरिंदमम्। रक्षां कृत्वा च पाण्डूनां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Having said this to Yudhishthira the repressor of foes and bestowed protection on the sons of Pandu the Goddess disappeared.

sa: यौधिष्ठिरस्तु संक्रुद्धः सौबलं निशितैः शरैः। व्यदारयत संसंग्रामे मघवानिव दानवम्॥
en: The son of Yudhishthira in great anger wounded Subala's son with many sharp arrows as Maghavat (Indra) mangles a Danava.

sa: मुहूर्तमिव तद् युद्धमासीन्मधुरदर्शनम्। तत उन्मत्तवद् राजन् न प्राज्ञायत किंचन॥
en: For a short time the battle looked beautiful, but O king, it soon grew furious and nothing could be seen.

sa: तोमरान् प्राहिणोच्छीघ्रं चतुर्दश शिलाशितान्। तानप्राप्तान् महाबाहुः खगतानेव पाण्डवः॥ चिच्छेद सहसा राजन्नसम्भ्रान्तो वरासिना। निकृत्य तु रणे भीमस्तोमरान् वै चतुर्दश॥
en: Soon hurled upon his fourteen darts with heads made of stone. The mighty armed Pandava (Bhima) soon cut them down into many fragments, O king, before they could reach him. Having cut down in that battle those fourteen arrows Bhima,

sa: तदनीकं महाबाहो भित्तवा परमदुर्जयम्। बलेन महता युक्ताः स्वर्गाय विजयैषिणः॥
en: Breaking through that invincible cavalry division of Iravat, desirous of victory and longing for paradise and endued with great strength,

sa: कुञ्जरैश्च सदा मत्तैः षट्सहस्रैः प्रहारिभिः। अभ्यरक्षन्त सहिता राक्षसेन्द्रं घटोत्कचम्॥
en: With six thousand highly infuriated elephants, all potent smiters, those heroes began to protect Ghatotkacha that foremost of the Rakshasas.

sa: ततः शरसहस्रेण क्षिप्रकारी निशाचरः। अर्जुनस्य सुतं संख्ये पीडयामास भारत॥
en: Then that ranger of the night, endued with great lightness, afflicted Arjuna's son in battle, OBharata, with thousands of arrows.

sa: अपीडयेतां समरे त्रिगर्तानां महद् बलम्। सुशर्माऽपि रणे पार्थं शरैर्नवभिराशुगैः॥
en: Afflicted in battle the mighty division of Trigarta troops; thereupon Susharma pierced Partha in battle with nine swift causing arrows.

sa: ततो युद्धं सुदुर्धर्षं व्याकुलं समपद्यत। शूराणां समरे तत्र समासाद्येतरेतरम्॥
en: Thus battle then became confused and fearful in the extreme. The heroes rushed against one another in a great number.

sa: इरावानपि संकुद्धः सर्वांस्तान् निशितैः शरैः। मोहयामास समरे विद्ध्वा परपुरंजयः॥
en: Thereupon Iravat, conqueror of hostile cities, waxing worth, piercing all of them with whetted shafts, deprived them of their senses.

sa: तेन मायामयाः सृष्टा हयास्तावन्त एव हि। स्वारूढा राक्षसैोरैः शूलपट्टिशधारिभिः॥
en: He then created, as many illusive chargers, all mounted by fierce Rakshasas, bearing in their hands lances and battle axes.

sa: युधिष्ठिरमुखाः पार्थाः पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम्। अयोधयन् रणे भीष्मं सहिताः सर्वसुंजयैः॥
en: The Partha's accompanied by the Srinjayas, and headed by Yudhishthira himself, with Shikhandin at their van fought on with Bhishma.

sa: पतत्यथ गजे चापि वङ्गानामीश्वरो बली। जवेन समभिदुत्य जगाम धरणीतलम्॥
en: The mighty ruler of the Bangas quickly leaping up from his elephant, jumped down on the surface of the earth.

sa: त्रिभिः शरैर्महाराज वासुदेवं च पञ्चभिः। भीमसेनं च नवभिर्वाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्॥
en: With three arrows, and the son of Vasudeva with five and Bhimasena on the breast and arms with nine shafts.

sa: संक्रुद्धो भरतश्रेष्ठ पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। वेगवन्तं महारौद्रं विद्युज्जिद्वं प्रमाथिनम्॥ शरैश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो निजघान महाबलः। ततः पुनरमेयात्मा शरवर्षं दुरासदम्॥ मुमोच भतरश्रेष्ठो निशाचरबलं प्रति। तत् तु दृष्टवा महत् कर्म पुत्रस्य तव मारिष।॥
en: Your irate son Duryodhana, O foremost of the Bharatas, that mighty car-warrior slew with four shafts, the four Rakshasas viz., Vegavana, Maharaudra, Vidyutjivha, and Pramathin. Once more, that one of immeasurable soul shot, O foremost of Bharatas, a shower of arrows incapable being ruffled, at the host of the Rakshasas. Beholding, O sire, that marvelous feat achieved by sour son,

sa: हाहाकारो महानासीत् सर्वसैन्येषु भारत। तमिषु संधितं दृष्ट्वा भारद्वाजेन संयुगे॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, seeing that arrow aimed by the son of Bharadvaja, all the troops cried "Oh" and "Alas".

sa: रथा विंशतिसाहस्रा ये तेषामनुयायिनः। हयानां दश कोट्यश्च महतां किंकिणीकिनाम्॥
en: And they followed him, with twenty thousand chariots, and a hundred million steeds (of that mighty army) with great bells,

sa: वामं चक्रं युधामन्युरुत्तमौजाश्च दक्षिणम्। गोप्तारौ फाल्गुनं प्राप्तौ फाल्गुनोऽपि शिखण्डिनः।।१९।
en: Yudhamanyu protects the left and Uttamaujas protects the right of Phalguna (Arjuna). Thus protected by these Phalguna himself protects Shikhandin.

sa: तथैव मद्रराजोऽपि भीमं दृष्ट्वा महाबलम्। ससाराभिमुखस्तूर्णं शार्दूल इव कुञ्जरम्॥
en: Also the mighty-powerful king of the Madras, beholding Bhima, rushed at him with impetuosity, like a tiger attacking an elephant.

sa: ततस्ता राजशार्दूल धात्र्यो दाशार्णिकास्तदा। जग्मुरार्ति परां प्रेष्याः प्रेषयामासुरेव च॥
en: Then those nurses from the Dasharnaka territories, O best among kings, became greatly afflicted, and dispatched emissaries (to their king).

sa: युधिष्ठिरः स्वयं राजा मद्रराजानमभ्ययात्। तस्य मद्राधिपश्चापं द्विधा चिच्छेद मारिष॥
en: The king Yudhishthira himself fought with the ruler of the Madra. The Madra king cut off the bow of Yudhishthira.

sa: तौ तु तत्र महेष्वासो महामात्रौ महारथौ। महता शरवर्षेण परस्परमविध्यताम्॥
en: Then those two fierce bowmen, both mighty car-warriors, and of gigantic proportions pierced each other with their thick arrows showers.

sa: श्वेतः खङ्गमथाकृष्य भीष्मस्य धनुराच्छिनत्। तदपास्य धनुश्छिन्नं त्वरमाणः पितामहः॥ देवदूतवचः श्रुत्वा वधे तस्य मनो दधे। ततः प्रचरमाणस्तु पिता देवव्रतस्तव॥
en: Shveta took up a sword and cut off Bhishma's bow. Throwing off that bow the (Kuru) grandfather having heard the words of the celestial messenger set his heart to destroy Shveta as soon as possible. Though baffled, your father Devavrata.

sa: अश्वत्थामा तथा शल्यः काम्बोजश्च सुदक्षिणः। विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ बाह्निकः सह बाल्हिकैः॥
en: Ashvathama, Shalya, Sudakshina the ruler of the Kambojas, the two Avanti princes Vinda and Anuvinda, and Balhika with the Balhikas,

sa: वध्यमानं ततस्तत्र शरैः पार्थस्य संयुगे। दुद्राव कौरवं सैन्यं विषादभयकम्पितम्॥
en: Thus slaughtered in the battle with the arrows of Partha, the Kuru army, trembling in grief and fear fled away.

sa: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम्। रजसस्तु फलंदुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्॥
en: The fruit of Sattva is good and untainted; the fruit of Raja is misery, and that of Tama is ignorance.

sa: तदन्तरममेयात्मा कौन्तेयः शत्रुतापनः। अभ्यद्रवद् रणे क्रुद्धो द्रोणं प्रति महारथः॥
en: At this crisis, that afflicter of foes that mighty car-warrior the son of Kunti, (Arjuna) waxing worth, rushed against Drona.

sa: अधर्माभिभवात् कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः। स्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसंकरः॥
en: From the predominance of sin, O Krishna, women become corrupt, and then O descendant of Vrishni, cross-breeds (mixed-castes) are borm.

sa: पञ्चालानां नरव्याघ्रो यः ख्यातो जनमेजयः। तस्य सर्षपपुष्पाणां तुल्यवर्णा हयोत्तमाः॥
en: Excellent steeds of the hue of the mustard flowers belonged to that foremost among the Panchalas, who well known Janamejaya.

sa: प्रावादयन्त संहृष्टाः पाण्डूनां तत्र सैनिकाः। अपश्यन् स्मयमानाश्च सौभद्रस्य विचेष्टितम्॥
en: Beholding that feat achieved by Subhadra's son, they were amazed. Then seeing their most implacable and arrogant adversary thus worsted,

sa: जघ्नतुर्विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैः परानीकविनाशनैः। द्रवमाणं तु तत् सैन्यं तव पुत्रस्य संयुगे॥
en: Slaughtered their troops with sharp arrows, each capable of destroying hostile heroes. Your those troops thus fled from the battle;

sa: किमियं वक्ष्यतीत्येवं विममर्श भृगूद्वहः। इति दध्यौ चिरं रामः कृपयाभिपरिप्लुतः॥
en: "What shall this one say?" So thought Bhrigu; thinking thus Rama was silent for a long time filled with pity.

sa: ततस्तूर्यसहस्रेषु नदत्सु स महाबलः॥ आस्फोटयामास भृशं भीमसेनो ननाद च।
en: Then when thousands of drums were struck up, the highly powerful Bhimasena uttered his fierce war-cries and slapped his arms.

sa: द्रावयित्वा महासैन्यं कम्पयित्वा महारथान्। नन्दयामास सुहृदो मयं जित्वेव वासवः॥
en: Thus shattering the mighty hostile army and causing the mighty car-warriors to tremble, the delighted his forces like queered Maya.

sa: विराटः सह पुत्रेण धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। भीमश्च केकयाचैव सात्यकिश्च विशाम्पते।॥
en: O king, these were Virata and his son, the descendant of Prishata, Dhrishtadyumna, Bhima, the five Kaikeya brothers, and Satyaki.

sa: प्रहरन् सर्वशत्रुभ्यः पाण्डवानां महारथः। अदृश्यत महेष्वासः सवज्र इव वासवः॥
en: That mighty car-warrior of the Pandava host smiting all his opponents, appeared like Vasava the wielder of the thunder bolt.

sa: मागधो यत्र नृपतिस्तद् रथानीकमन्वयात्॥ रथानां चक्ररक्षाश्च पादरक्षाश्च दन्तिनाम्। अभवन् वाहिनीमध्ये शतानामयुतानि षट्॥ पादाताश्चाग्रतोऽगच्छन् धनुश्चर्मासिपाणयः। अनेकशतसाहस्रा नखरप्रासयोधिनः। ॥ अक्षौहिण्यो दशैका च तव पुत्रस्य भारत। अदृश्यन्त महाराज गङ्गेव यमुनान्तरा॥
en: The Magadha king followed that large array of cars. those that protected the elephants, numbered six millions. The foot-soldiers, who marched in advance, armed with bows, swords and shields, numbered many hundred thousands. They fought with their nails and darts. O descendant of Bharata, O great king, your son's eleven Akshauhini of soldiers looked like Ganga separated from the Yamuna.

sa: अभ्यधावज्जिघांसन् वै शल्यं मद्राधिपं युधि। महता रथसंघेन समन्तात् परिरक्षितः॥
en: Rushed upon the Madra king with the intention of killing him. He was supported on all sides by innumerable car-warriors.

sa: तथैव पाण्डवा राजन् परिवब्रुः पितामहम्। स समन्तात् परिवृतो रथौधैरपराजितः॥
en: The Pandavas also surrounded the grandsire on all sides. That invincible one (Bhishma) surrounded by that mighty division of cars,

sa: न तत्रासीत् पुमान् कश्चिद् यो युद्धं नाभिकाङ्क्षति।।१९। एवं युयुधिरे वीराः प्रार्थयाना महद् यशः। तावकाः पाण्डवैः सार्धमाकाङ्क्षन्तो जयं युधि॥
en: There was no man who was not in flamed with a desire for battle. Thus did those heroic warriors of your army fight on with those of the Pandava, desiring great renown and ardently longing for securing victory in battle.

sa: तत: प्रववृते युद्धं तुमुलं लोमहर्षणम्। पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च द्रोणपाञ्चाल्ययोरपि॥
en: Then raged a dreadful and hair-stirring battle, between the Pandavas and the Kurus, as also between Drona and the Panchalas.

sa: न्यहनच्च पिता पुत्रं पुत्रश्च पितरं तथा। व्याकुलीकृतसर्वाङ्गा युयुधुस्तत्र मानवा॥
en: Father slew son and son slew father in that battle men fought on making the best use of all limbs.

sa: तत् तस्य चरितं दृष्ट्वा पौत्रस्तव विशाम्पते। लक्ष्मणोऽभ्यपतत् तूर्णं सात्वतीपुत्रमाहवे॥
en: Beholding those feats of Abhimanyu the son of Subhadra, O king, your grandson Lakshmana speedily faced him desirous of battle.

sa: तं प्रयान्तं ततः पश्चादाह्वयन्तो महारथाः। संशप्तकाः समारोहन् सहस्राणि चतुर्दश॥
en: As Arjuna winded his way towards Bhagadatta, the fourteen thousand mighty carwarriors, viz., the Samshaptakas summoned him delightfully from behind.

sa: हते विप्रदुते सैन्ये निरुत्साहे विमर्दिते। हाहाकारो महानासीत् पाण्डुसैन्येषु भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, being slaughtered in great numbers and crushed when retreating, the Pandava troops cried “Oh” and “Alas”.

sa: तेन यज्ञेर्बहुविधैरिष्टं पर्याप्तदक्षिणैः। स राजा वीर्यवान् धीमानवाप्य वसु पुष्कलम्॥
en: He celebrated various sacrifices attended with profuse sacrificial presents; that highly puissant and intelligent monarch acquired enormous quality of wealth.

sa: भीष्मं च समुदीर्यन्तं दृष्ट्वा पार्थ महाहवे। अवहारमकुर्वन्त सैन्यानां भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, seeing Bhishma still proudly standing in battle, the sons of Pritha withdrew their forces.

sa: शुचा परमया युक्तश्चिन्तयानः पराजयम्। वार्ष्णेयमब्रवीद् राजन् दृष्ट्वा भीष्मस्य विक्रमम्॥
en: Being greatly afflicted with the defeat and seeing Bhishma's prowess, O king, he thus spoke to the Vrishni chief (Krishna).

sa: अभिमन्युस्ततः शूर इरावांश्च ततः परम्॥ भैमसेनिस्ततो राजन् केकयाश्च महारथाः।
en: Next to them was Abhimanyu and then Iravana. Next to Iravana was Bhimasena's son (Ghatotkacha) with the great Kaikeya carwarriors.

sa: सूर्यवर्णैश्च निस्त्रिशैः पात्यमानानि सर्वशः। दिक्षु सर्वास्वदृश्यन्त शरीराणि शिरांसि च॥
en: In all directions were seen heads and limbs falling, being cut off with swords of the effulgence of the sun.

sa: पुत्राणां तव दुर्धर्ष पाण्डवानां तथैव च। समकम्पन्त सैन्यानि परस्परसमागमे॥
en: O invincible hero, the troops of your sons and those of the Pandavas both trembled when they met each other.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु पाण्डव: कृष्णसारथिः। आजगाम महाराज निनशत्रून् समन्ततः॥
en: At this juncture, O king, that son of Pandu, whose charioteer is Krishna, came destroying his foes right and left,

sa: विव्यथे न च राजेन्द्र तव पुत्रो जनेश्वर। धृष्टद्युम्नं च समरे तूर्णं विव्याध पत्रिभिः॥ षष्ट्या च त्रिंशता चैव तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्। तस्य सेनापतिः क्रुद्धो धनुश्चिच्छेद मारिष॥
en: Your son, that lord of men, neither wavered nor was agitated with fear, on the other hand, he quickly pierced Dhrishtadyumna with arrows in that conflict. Numbering sixty (first) and thirty (next). all this seemed highly wonderful. Thereupon the generalissimo of the Pandavas, waxing wroth, O Bharata, cut off Duryodhana's bow.

sa: सौभद्रमथ संसक्तं दृष्ट्वा तत्र धनंजयः। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन त्रातुकामः स्वमात्मजम्॥
en: Seeing Subhadra's fighting, Dhananjaya (Arjuna) hastened to the spot in great anger, with the intention of rescuing his son son.

sa: स नागः प्रेषितस्तेन बाणो ज्याचोदितो यथा। अभ्यधावत वेगेन भीमसेनमरिंदमम्॥
en: Like an arrow shot from the bowstring, that elephant, O subduer of foes, directed by Bhagadatta, impetuously rushed against Bhimasena.

sa: ते घोरा रौद्रकर्माणो विपाठा बहवः शिताः। निघ्नतो रथनागाश्वाञ्जग्मुराशु वसुंधराम्॥
en: Those dreadful shafts of terrible effects and touch, penetrating penetrating through car-warriors, elephants and horses, struck on the earth's surface.

sa: एवं ब्रुवन्तस्ते सर्वे प्रतिरुथ्य रणाजिरम्। न्यासयांचक्रिरे शस्त्रं पितरो भृगुनन्दनम्॥
en: Addressing him with these words, and obstructing the battle-field, his forefathers made the descendant of Bhrigu lay aside his weapons.

sa: ततः सायंमनिः क्रुद्धौ दृष्ट्वा निहतमात्मजम्। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन पाञ्चाल्यं युद्धदुर्मदम्॥
en: Thereafter, beholding his own son slain, Samyamani inflamed with wrath, impetuously fell upon the Panchala prince, ever invincible in battle.

sa: ततो धनंजयस्तत्र वर्तमाने महारणे। आजगाम रथेनाजो भीमं दृष्ट्वा महारथम्॥
en: Then whom the combat was thus raging fiercely, Dhananjaya came there on his car, and beheld Bhima that mighty car-warrior.

sa: वामं चक्रं युधामन्युरुत्तमौजाश्च दक्षिणम्। गोप्तारौ फाल्गुनं प्राप्तौ फाल्गुनोऽपि शिखण्डिनः।।१९।
en: Yudhamanyu protects the left and Uttamaujas protects the right of Phalguna (Arjuna). Thus protected by these Phalguna himself protects Shikhandin.

sa: स च पारावताश्वस्य रथे हेमपरिष्कृते। कोविदारध्वजं दृष्ट्वा भीमसेनः समाश्वसत्॥
en: Seeing the red standard of Dhrishtadyumna's car decked with gold and yoked with milk white steeds, Bhimasena became much encouraged.

sa: स्वलंकृतमिदं वेश्म स्थूणस्यामितविक्रमाः। नोपसर्पति मां चैव कस्मादद्य स मन्दधीः॥
en: This mansion of Sthuna is well-adorned, O you (followers) of immeasurable powers. Why does not this fool, however, approach me?

sa: अथापरे च राजानः परिवृत्य समन्ततः। महाबला रणे शूराः पञ्चालानन्ववारयन्॥
en: Other kings also endued with great mighty and heroism began to oppose the Panchalas, having surrounded them on all sides.

sa: द्रोणमभ्युद्यतं दृष्ट्वा पाण्डवाः सह सृञ्जयैः॥४४॥ प्रत्यगृणंस्तदा राजञ्छरवर्षैः पृथक् पृथक्।
en: Beholding Drona charge, the Pandavas along with the Srinjayas received him, o monarch, with showers of shafts in distinct sets.

sa: सहदेवं शकुनये चेकितानं शलाय वै। द्रौपदेयांस्तथा पञ्च त्रिगर्तेभ्यः समादिशत्॥
en: He also appointed Sahadeva to fight with Shakuni, Chekitana with Shala, and the five sons of Draupadi with the Trigartas,

sa: संजय उवाच सैनापत्यमनुप्राप्य भीष्मः शान्तनवो नृप। दुर्योधनमुवाचेदं वचनं हर्षयन्निव॥
en: Sanjaya said Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, having obtained the generalship, said these words to Duryodhana infusing cheerfulness in him.

sa: मूनि चैनमुपाघ्राय परिष्वज्य च बाहुना। आशिषः परमाः प्रोच्य स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Having locked Arjuna in his affectionate embrace and having smelled the crown of his head and pronouncing best benedictions of

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा लोहितायति भास्करे। अब्रवीत् तावकान् सर्वांस्त्वध्वमिति भारत॥
en: Then, 0 Bharata, when the lustrous orb assume a crimson hue, king Duryodhana addressing all your warriors said, "make hasten".

sa: भवद्भिपलब्धानि कथितानि च संसदि। पाण्डवा वासुदेवश्च विदिता मम सर्वशः॥
en: Were seen and declared in the assembly by you. I perfectly know that the Pandavas and the son of Vasudeva.

sa: अर्जुनोऽथ सुशर्मादीन् राज्ञस्तान् सपदानुगान्। विजित्य पृतनामध्ये ययौ स्वशिबिरं प्रति॥
en: Arjuna having conquered the kings headed by Susharma along with their followers, proceeded through the divisions towards his own tent.

sa: एतस्य हि महाराज यथा गाण्डीवधन्वनः। शरासनविनिर्मुक्ताः संसक्ता यान्ति सायकाः॥
en: The arrows, shot by him from his bow as by the wielder of the Gandiva bow, proceed touching one another.

sa: शराश्चापानि खङ्गाश्च शरीराणि शिरांसि च। सकुण्डलानि स्रग्वीणि भूमावासन् सहस्रशः॥
en: Arrows and bows and swords and corpses and heads with ear-rings and garlands were seen on the ground by hundreds.

sa: बबनर्थकरं पापमेकोऽहं समवाप्नुयाम्। सहाय एव कार्येषु च कृच्छ्रेषु दृश्यते॥
en: And I am alone to suffer from this great evil; I do not get any help at my this difficulty.

sa: क्षीरोदमथनं चैव जन्मोच्चैःश्रवसस्तथा। यजतः सर्पसत्रेण राज्ञः पारिक्षितस्य च॥ कथेयमभिनिर्वृत्ता भरतानां महात्मनाम्। विविधाः संभवा राज्ञामुक्ता: संभवपर्वणि॥ अन्येषां चैव शूराणामृषेद्वैपायनस्य च। अंशावतरणं चात्र देवानां परिकीर्तितम्॥
en: That of the churning of the ocean, the birth of Uchaishrava and last of all, the Bharata dynasty as described at the snake-sacrifice of king Parikshit. Sambhava Parva treats of the births of various kings. sages and heroes and that of the sage, Krishna Dvaipayana, the partial incarnations of the celestials,

sa: एवमुक्त्वा दुहितरं समाश्वास्य स भार्गवः। पुनर्जगाम ब्रह्मर्षिर्भवनं स्वं महायशाः॥
en: Having thus imprecated the curse and consoled his sorrowful daughter the highly illustrious Rși Bhārgava repaired to his own habitation.

sa: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य शाल्वराजस्य कौरवः। भीष्मो नृपतिशार्दूल न्यवधीत् तस्य सारथिम्॥
en: O best of Kings, the Kuru prince, warding off with his weapons those of his foe, killed king Shalva's charioteer.

sa: भीमसेनार्जुनौ यत्र संरब्धान् पृथिवीपतीन्। शल्यकर्णौ च तरसा जितवन्तौ महामृधे॥
en: The defeat of Shalya, Karna and all the angry kings by powerful Bhima and Arjuna in the battle that ensued.

sa: अभिसारी ततो रम्यां विजिग्ये कुरुनन्दनः। उरगावासिनं चैव रोचमानं रणेऽजयत्॥
en: That descendant of Kuru (Arjuna) then conquered the charming city, named Abhisari. He then vanquished Rochamana, who ruled in urga.

sa: शशंस रामाय युधिष्ठिरं स भीमं सजिष्णुं च यमौ च वीरौ। शनैः शनैस्तान् प्रसमीक्ष्य रामो जनार्दनं प्रीतमना ददर्श ह॥
en: He said to Rama (Balarama), “That is Yudhishthira, that is Bhima with Jishnu (Arjuna) and these are the two heroic twins (Nakula and Sahadeva). "Observing them slowly (one after the other) (Bala) Rama cast a pleased glance on Janardana (Krishna).

sa: तत्राशु पुरुषव्याघ्रः पाण्डवेयो धनंजयः। मोक्षयिष्यति शुद्धात्मा दुःखादस्मान्न संशयः॥ तस्य सर्वा वयं वीर श्रुत्वा वाक्यमिहागताः। तदिदं सत्यमेवाद्य मोक्षिताहं त्वयानघ॥
en: That best of men the pure-souled Pandava Dhananjaya (Arjuna) will certainly deliver you from your this distressful state.” O hero, hearing the Rishi's words, all of us came here. O sinless one, I have been really delivered by you to-day.

sa: तथा भीष्मः शान्तनवो विदुरश्च महामतिः। सर्वशः कौरवाश्चैव प्राणदन् भृशदुःखिताः॥
en: Then the son of Shantanu, Bhishma, the high-souled Vidura and all the other Kurus became disconsolate in grief and sorrow.

sa: एवमतिरथाः सप्त राजन्नन्यान् निबोध मे। कृतवर्मा ह्यनाधृष्टिः समीकः समिर्तिजयः॥
en: O king, these seven are Atirathas, Besides these there are others, whom I shall (Presently) mention. Kritavarma, Anadhrishti, Samika, Samitinajaya.

sa: ता वयं चिन्तयित्वैव मुहूर्तादिव भारत। दृष्टवत्यो महाभागं देवर्षिमुत नारदम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, as we were, thinking, at that very moment we met with the illustrious celestials Rishi Narada.

sa: एवं तयोक्तो भगवान्नीहारमसृजत्प्रभुः। येन देशः स सर्वस्तु तमोभूत इवाभवत्॥
en: Thus addressed by her, the illustrious lord (Parashara) created a fog, by which the whole place was covered with darkness.

sa: तद्दारग्रहणे यत्नं संतत्यां च मनः कुरु। पुत्रकास्मन्नियोगात्त्वमेतन्नः परमं हितम्॥
en: Therefore, O son, set your mind upon marriage and offspring at our command. It will do us the highest good.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तया भीष्मः कन्यया विप्रसंसदि। चिन्तामभ्यगमद् वीरो युक्तां तस्यैव कर्मणः॥
en: Thus addressed by that maiden before the Brahmanas, the heroic Bhishma began to reflect what should be done. to my

sa: एतदर्हा वयं नूनं वसामो दुर्बलस्य ये। विषये नित्यवास्तव्याः कुराजानमुपाश्रिताः॥
en: We certainly deserve it all, for we live in everlasting anxiety in the kingdom of a wretched and weak king.

sa: भिन्नानामतुलो नाशः क्षिप्रमेव प्रवर्तते। तस्माद्विभागं भ्रातृणां न प्रशंसन्ति साधवः॥
en: Absolute ruin very soon overtakes those (brothers) that are separated. Therefore, good men never approve of the partition amongst brothers,

sa: यावद्धनं प्रार्थयसे राजस्तस्मात्ततोऽधिकम्। गृहाण मत्त एव त्वं संनिवर्तस्व चानघ॥
en: "O sinless one, take from me more wealth than you expect to get from that king. And then go back."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच क्षत्रियाणां वचः श्रुत्वा भीष्मश्चक्रोध भारत!!) भीष्मस्तदा स्वयं कन्या वरयामास ताः प्रभुः॥ उवाच च महीपालान् राजञ्जलदनिस्वनः। रथमारोप्य ताः कन्या भीष्मः प्रहरतां वरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O Bharata, hearing the words of those kings, Bhishma became angry. Bhishma, the lord, chose himself those maidens (for his brother). O king, taking those maidens on his chariot, the best of warriors, Bhishma, spoke to the (assembled) kings in a voice like the thunder of the clouds.

sa: संवत्सरद्वयं तं तु गान्धारी गर्भमाहितम्॥ अप्रजा धारयामास ततस्तां दुःखमाविशत्।
en: She bore the burden in her womb for two years without being delivered; she was, therefore, much afflicted with grief.

sa: ततः प्रहस्य तद्रक्षः शूलं जग्राह पाणिना। वधाय सानुबन्धस्य मुमोचायुधमुत्तमम्॥
en: Laughing wild Lavaņa took up the dart in his hand and discharged it to destroy the king with his followers.

sa: पुण्या वाता ववुश्चैव गन्धवन्तः सुखप्रदाः। पपात पुष्पवृष्टिश्च देवैर्मुक्ता महौघवत्॥
en: There blew the holy, fragrant and delightful winds and there fell profusely celestial flowers from the hands of the deities.

sa: अथ तं पुरुषव्याघ्रमन्तर्जलचरो महान्। जग्राह चरणे ग्राहः कुन्तीपुत्रं धनंजयम्॥
en: Thereupon a large crocodile under the water seized the leg of that best of men, the son of Kunti Dhananjaya.

sa: दृष्ट्वा निवारितान् देवान् माधवेनार्जुनेन च॥ आश्चर्यमगमंस्तत्र मुनयो नभसि स्थिताः।
en: Seeing the celestial routed by Madhava (Krishna) and Arjuna. The Rishis who were in the sky became very much astonished.

sa: एवं राजन्नहिच्छत्रा पुरी जनपदायुता। युधि निर्जित्य पार्थेन द्रोणारा प्रतिपादिता॥
en: Which was full of towns and cities and which was bestowed upon him by Partha after defeating the hero (Drupada).

sa: अभिगम्य च राजानं नियमेन समाहितः॥ अभ्यर्च्य ब्राह्मणान् पार्थो द्रौपदीमभिजग्मिवान्।
en: He went to Yudhishthira and worshipped him first; he then worshipped the Brahmanas and at last he went to Draupadi.

sa: श्रुत्वा भरतसिंहस्य विविधाः करुणा गिरः। भीममार्तस्वरं कृत्वा हाहेति परिचुक्रुशुः॥
en: Hearing these and other sorrowful words of that lion of the Bharata race, bewailed in grief and cried, "Alas! O!"

sa: प्रद्युम्नसाम्बनिशद्दांश्चारुदेष्णं गदं तथा। अनिरुद्धं च भानुं च परिष्वज्य जनार्दनः॥
en: Worshipping his old father and his illustrious mother, and saluting Baladeva (his brother) also, the lotus-eyed (hero) took his seat.

sa: मार्तण्डस्य मनु/मानजायत सुतः प्रभुः। यमश्चापि सुतो जज्ञे ख्यातस्तस्यानुजः प्रभुः॥
en: Martanda (Vaivasvata) begot another son who was gifted with great intelligence and was called Manu. Yama was his younger brother.

sa: तथा राजर्षयः सर्वे ब्राह्मणाश्च तपोधनाः। चक्रुरुच्चावचं कर्म यशसोऽर्थाय दुष्करम्॥
en: All the royal sages and Brahmanas, Possessed of ascetic wealth, have achieved the most difficult of feats for fame alone.

sa: एवंगुणस्य नृपतेस्तथावृत्तस्य कौरव। तस्मै दातुं मनश्चक्रे तपतीं तपनः स्वयम्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, Tapana himself resolved upon bestowing Tapati on the king (Samvarana) endued with such virtue and accomplishments.

sa: दशपुत्रसहस्राणि दशज्योतेर्महात्मनः। ततो दशगुणाश्चान्ये शतज्योतेरिहात्मजाः॥ भूयस्ततो दशगुणाः सहस्रज्योतिषः सुताः। तेभ्योऽयं कुरुवंशश्च यदूनां भरतस्य च॥ ययातीक्ष्वाकुवंशश्च राजर्षीणां च सर्वशः। संभूता बहवो वंशा भूतसर्गाः सुविस्तराः॥
en: Famous Dashajyoti had ten thousands, Shatajyoti had ten times that number and Sahasrajyoti, ten times the number of the clisprings of Shatajyoti. From them descended the race of the Kurus, Yadus and Bharata and also that of Yayati and Ikshvaku and all the Rajarshis. There were also produced numerous other generations.

sa: ते शराचितसर्वाङ्गा निनदन्तो महारवान्। ऊर्ध्वमुत्पत्य वेगेन निपेतुः खाण्डवे पुनः॥
en: Being pierced by Arjuna's arrows the flying birds again fell into the Khandava with great speed and uttering loud cries.

sa: तत्र गत्वा स धर्मज्ञः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः। दुपदं न्यायतो राजन् संयुक्तमुपतस्थिवान्॥
en: O king, having arrived there, that virtuous man, learned in all the Shastras, properly addressed Drupada and waited upon him.

sa: आत्मना च महाबाहुरेकपादस्थितोऽभवत्। उग्रं च तप आस्थाय परमेण समाधिना॥ आरिराधयिषुर्देवं त्रिदशानां तमीश्वरम्। सूर्येण सह धर्मात्मा पर्यतप्यत भारत॥ तं तु कालेन महता वासवः प्रत्यपद्यता
en: That mighty-armed man (Pandu), himself stood upon his one leg and began to perform the severest asceticism and penances. He practiced severe austerities from morning to evening with his mind deep in meditation in order to gratify the lord of the celestials. It was after a long time that Indra appeared.

sa: हित्वा प्रासादनिलयं शुभानि शयनानि च। अरण्यनित्यः सततं बभूव मृगयापरः॥
en: He left his excellent palace and its luxurious bed. He lived always in the forest, being ever engaged in hunting.

sa: इदं शरणमाग्नेयं मदर्षमिति मे मतिः। पुरोचनेन विहितं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य शासनात्॥
en: I know this inflammable house was built for me by Purochana at the command of the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana).

sa: ततो माद्री विचार्यैवं जगाम मनसाश्चिनौ। तावागम्य सुतौ तस्यां जनयामासतुर्यमौ॥
en: Thereupon, Madri reflecting sometime, thought of the twin Asvinis. They came to her without delay and begot offspring on her.

sa: जवे लक्ष्याभिहरणे भोज्ये पांसुविकर्षणे। धार्तराष्ट्रान् भीमसेनः सर्वान् स परिमर्दति॥
en: In speed, in striking the object aimed at, in eating, in scattering dust, Bhimasena beat all the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: ततो महीतलं तात क्षत्रियेण यदृच्छया।॥ खनताधिगतं वित्तं केनचिद् भृगुवेश्मनि।
en: (It happened, however) that Kshatriyas, in digging at pleasure a certain house of a Bhrigu, came upon a large treasure.

sa: भृगूणां तु धनं ज्ञात्वा राजानः सर्व एव याचिष्णवोऽभिजग्मुस्तांस्ततो भार्गवसत्तमान्।
en: Knowing that the Bhrigus were rich, those kings all went in the grab of baggers to those best of Bhrigus.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा रक्षिणस्तत्र तथा बहुतिथेऽहनि। न्यवेदयंस्तथा राज्ञे यथावृत्तं नराधिप॥
en: O king, the guards, having seen him after many days in that state, told the king all that had happened.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा स धर्मात्मा जरत्कारुर्महानृषिः। उग्राय तपसे भूयो जगाम कृतनिश्चयः॥
en: Having said this, the virtuous and great Rishi Jaratkaru went away, his heart firmly fixed on practising severest asceticism again.

sa: द्रौणिः क्रोधसमाविष्टः पितुर्वधमनुस्मरन्। पञ्चालानां प्रसुप्तानां वधं प्रति मनो दधे॥
en: Seeing this, Ashvathama, his heart being full of rage, remembering the death of his father, determined kill the sleeping Panchalas.

sa: ब्राह्मणं ब्राह्मणीं चैव मिथुनायोपसंगतौ। तौ तं वीक्ष्य सुवित्रस्तावकृतार्थी प्रधावितौ॥
en: A Brahmana and a Brahmani engaged in sexual intercourse. Seeing him they fled away in fear, their desire being unfulfilled.

sa: ततः सुप्रीतमनसस्ते नृपा नृपसत्तम। तथेत्येवाब्रुवन् सर्वे प्रतिगृह्यास्य तां गिरम्॥
en: O best of kings, thereupon all those monarchs, saying "Be it so, “accepted with joyous heart all that Krishna said.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा तस्य राजर्षेर्नष्टसंज्ञस्य भाषितम्। प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं सान्त्वयन्परया गिरा॥
en: Hearing the words of the royal saint, who had lost all recollection, Budha, with sweet words consoled him and said.

sa: ततः प्रहृष्टः काकुत्स्थः श्रुत्वा वाक्यं महात्मनः। ऋषींस्तत्र समेतांश्च राज्ञश्चैवाभ्यभाषत॥
en: Hearing the words of the high-souled Valmiki, Rama was greatly delighted. Having addressed the assembled Rșis and kings he said.

sa: ततो वररथारूढाः कुमारा: सादिभिः सह। प्रविश्य नगरं सर्वे राजमार्गमुपाययुः॥
en: The princes, riding on first class chariots and followed by cavalry, entered the hostile capital and proceeded along its streets.

sa: इन्द्रो हि राजा देवानां प्रधान इति नः श्रुतम्। अप्रमेयबलोत्साहो वीर्यवानमितद्युतिः॥ तं तोषयित्वा तपसा पुत्रं लप्स्ये महाबलम्। यं दास्यति स मे पुत्रं स वरीयान् भविष्यति॥ अमानुषान् मानुषांश्च संग्रामे स हनिष्यति। कर्मणा मनसा वाचा तस्मात् तप्स्ये महत् तपः॥
en: We have heard that Indra is the foremost (among the celestial) and the king of the Devas. He is endued with immeasurable might, energy, Prowess and glory. Gratifying him by my asceticism, I shall obtain a greatly powerful son. The son that he will give me will be superior to all. He will be capable of defeating the inhabitants of earth and those who are not of this earth. I shall, therefore practice severest asceticism with heart, deed and speech."

sa: स तस्याः शीलवृत्तेन रूपौदार्यगुणेन च। उपचारेण च रहस्तुतोष जगतीपतिः॥
en: The lord of the world, king Shantanu, became very much pleased with her beauty, conduct, magnanimity and attention to comforts.

sa: अयमस्मानपाहाय दुःखे चाधाय शाश्वते। कृत्वा चास्माननातांश्च क्व यास्यति नराधिपः॥
en: The Citizen said : O king, where do you go, leaving us behind and making us miserable and wretched forever?

sa: शक्तः संहननो वाग्मी सौवीरीतनयास्त्रयः। मनस्योरभवन् पुत्राः शूराः सर्वे महारथाः॥
en: Manasyu begot on his wife Sauviri three sons, namely Shakta, Sanhanana and Vagmi; they were all great heroes and car-warriors.

sa: इन्द्रहस्ताच्च्युतो नागः ख एव यदतिष्ठत। ततश्चिन्तापरो राजा बभूव जनमेजयः॥
en: The snake, (Takshaka) though thrown off form Indra's hands, remained in the air without falling. Thereupon, king Janamejaya became thoughtful,

sa: स निक्षिप्य सुतं ज्येष्ठं पौरेषु मधुरेश्वरम्। तप उग्रं समातिष्ठत्तापयन्सर्वदेवताः॥
en: Having resolved thus and placed his son Madhureśvara on the throne Vſtra engaged in austerities creating terror to all deities.

sa: ददाह कुंजरांस्तत्र सिंहांश्चैव विनिर्गतान्। विगतासूनि सर्वाणि सत्त्वानि विविधानि च॥
en: It burnt the lions, elephants and other various creatures that were on the mountain and killed them (on the spot).

sa: भगवन्तः सशिष्या वै सानुगाश्च नराधिपाः। पश्यन्तु सीताशपथं यश्चैवान्योऽपि काङ्क्षते।।१३
en: The Rșis with their disciples, and the kings with their followers and all others willing shall see Sitā swear here.

sa: ताः श्रुत्वा सोमपुत्रस्य स्त्रियः किंपुरुषीकृताः। उपासांचक्रिरे शैलं वध्वस्ता बहुलास्तदा॥
en: According to the words of Budha they lived in that mountains as Kimpuruşas. In this wise many Kimpurusa-Budhas were procreated.

sa: सौतिरुवाच यथा कथितवान्ब्रह्मन्प्रमतिः पूर्वजस्तव। पुत्राय रुरवे प्रीतः पृच्छते भार्गवोत्तम।॥
en: O Brahmana, O best of the Bhrigu-race, as your ancestor Pramati had gladly narrated it to his enquiring son Ruru,

sa: सप्तरात्रं च काकुत्स्थो राघवस्य यथाज्ञया। उष्य तत्र महेष्वासो गमनायोपचक्रमे॥
en: Thereupon Satrughna, well-skilled in the use of bows, remained with Rāma for seven nights and then addressed himself for departure.

sa: अनन्तो भगवान्देवो यतो नारायणस्ततः। शिर उत्क्षिप्य नागस्य पुनः पुनरवाक्षिपत्॥
en: And Ananta, who was a manifested form of Narayana, again and again raised and lowered the hood of the Naga.

sa: न चाप्याचरितः पूर्वैरयं धर्मो महात्मभिः। न चाप्यधर्मो विद्वद्भिश्चरितव्यः कथंचन॥
en: The illustrious men of former ages had never such an usage amongst them. The wise should never commit a sin,

sa: स तं गृह्य नृपश्रेष्ठः सचिवानिदमब्रवीत्। अस्तमभ्येति सविता विषादद्य न मे भयम्॥ सत्यवागस्तु स मुनिः कृमिर्मी दशतामयम्। तक्षको नाम भूत्वा वै तथा परिहृतं भवेत्॥
en: “The sun is setting. I have no longer any fear from the poison today. Therefore, let this insect, becoming Takshaka, bite me, so that my sinful act be expitiated and the word of the ascetic may be true. And those councillors, impelled by Fate, approved of the speech of the king.

sa: ते समानीतमात्रे तु शकले पुरुषर्षभ। एकमूर्तिधरो वीरः कुमारः समपद्यत॥
en: O best of men, as soon as the fragments were united, they formed into a heroic child of one body.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चापि गरुडः काल आगते। विना मात्रा महातेजा विदार्याण्डमजायत॥
en: Meanwhile, when the time came, Garuda of great splendour came out bursting the egg without the help of his mother.

sa: ततो द्वैपायनस्तस्मै नरेन्द्राय महात्मने। आचख्यौ तद् यथा धर्मो बहूनामेकपत्निता॥
en: Thereupon Dvaipayana explained to that illustrious king how the marriage of one wife with many husbands is conformable to virtue.

sa: अनुगृह्य सुहृद्वर्ग भोगैश्वर्यसुखेन च। पितृपैतामहं राज्यमिमे भोक्ष्यन्ति ते सुताः॥
en: Maintaining their friends and relatives in luxury and affluence, these your so will rule over the kingdom of their forefathers.

sa: तस्यैवं भाषितं श्रुत्वा राघवः परमार्तवत्। उवाच सुहृदः सर्वान्कथमेतद्वदन्तु माम्॥
en: Hearings those words of Bhadra, Raghava was greatly sorry and asked his friends “Do the subjects thus talk about me?”

sa: सौकन्यमपि चाख्यानं च्यवनो यत्र भार्गवः। शर्यातियज्ञे नासत्यौ कृतवान् सोमपीतिनौ॥
en: The story Sukanya in which Bhrigu's son, Chyavana, made the Ashvinis drink Soma Juice at the sacrifice of king Sharyati,

sa: भयार्ताय ततस्तस्मै कृष्णो दत्त्वाभयं तदा। आददेऽस्य महार्हाणि रत्नानि पुरुषोत्तमः॥
en: That best of men (Krishna) gave every assurance to that very much frightened prince and accepted his very valuable presents.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः। दृष्ट्वा तु दुर्निमित्तानि जरासंधमदर्शयन्॥
en: At that very time the Veda-knowing Brahmanas inhabiting the city saw many evil omens which they duly reported to Jarasandha.

sa: लक्षणं चैतदेवेह भविता ते नराधिप। इन्द्रमालेति विख्यातं धन्यमप्रतिमं महत्॥
en: O king of men, this excellent, matchless and great garland, widely known as Indra's garland, will be your distinctive badge.

sa: शत्रुघ्नशरनिर्भिन्नो लवणः स निशाचरः। पपात सहसा भूमौ वज्राहत इवाचलः॥
en: And being pierced by that shaft the nightranger Lavaņa fell down on earth like a mountain clapped by a thunder-bolt.

sa: प्रविष्टायां तु सीतायां भूतलं सत्यसंपदा। तस्यावसाने यज्ञस्य रामः परमदुर्मनाः॥
en: Sītā having entered Pātāla by the strength of her vow, and the sacrifice having terminated, Rāma grew poorly in spirit.

sa: ताः सर्वगुणसम्पन्ना भ्राता भ्रात्रे यवीयसे। भीष्मो विचित्रवीर्याय प्रददौ विक्रमाहृताः॥
en: That mighty armed hero wishing his brother's welfare brought those greatly accomplished maidens and then offered them to his brother.

sa: प्रत्यूषश्च प्रभासश्च वसवोऽष्टौ प्रकीर्तिताः। धूम्रायास्तु धरः पुत्रो ब्रह्मविद्यो ध्रुवस्तथा॥
en: Pratyusha and Prabhasa. These are known to be the eight Vasus. Dhara and the Brahmaknowing Dhruva were born of Dhumra.

sa: इदं चोवाच वचनं रुरुमप्रतिमौजसम्। अहिंसा परमो धर्मः सर्वप्राणभृतां वर॥
en: He then addressed Ruru of incomparable power, saying, “O best of beings, the highest morality is not to hurt others.

sa: ततो मुहूर्तान्मधुरां वाणीमुच्चार्य पार्षतः। पप्रच्छ तं महात्मानं द्रौपद्यर्थं विशाम्पते॥
en: Thereupon a moment after the son of Prishata in sweet words asked that illustrious man about the marriage of Draupadi.

sa: मधुरेणैव राज्यस्य तेषामधु प्रदीयताम्। एतद्धि पुरुषव्याघ्र हितं सर्वजनस्य च॥
en: Give them in peace the half of the kingdom. O best of men, this is for the good of all.

sa: यत्र राज्यं परित्यज्य पाण्डवाः पुरुषर्षभाः। द्रौपद्या सहिता देव्या महाप्रस्थानमास्थिताः॥
en: It relates that the best of men, the Pandavas, abdicating their kingdom went with Draupadi in their great journey (Mahaprasthana.)

sa: श्रुत्वा तु धृतराष्ट्रस्तद् राजा सुमहदप्रियम्। विनाशं पाण्डुपुत्राणां विललाप सुदुःखितः॥
en: Hearing the great evil news of the death of the sons of Pandu, the king Dhritarashtra bewailed in great sorrow.

sa: स तु पृष्टस्तदा देवैस्तत: कारणमब्रवीत्। प्रत्यगृह्णस्तु देवाश्च तद् वचोऽङ्गिरसस्तदा॥
en: Having been thus addressed by the celestials, he told them the reason; and the celestials accepted the explanation of Angiras.

sa: निक्षिपाम्यहमग्नित्वं त्वमग्निः प्रथमो भव। भविष्यामि द्वितीयोऽहं प्राजापत्यक एव च॥
en: I have relinquished my god-hood of fire, do you become primeval fire. I shall act as the second Prajapatya fire.

sa: निर्जग्मुस्ते शनैः सर्वे समाजग्मुश्च भारत। प्रतस्थिरे पुनर्वीराः पर्वतं गन्धमादनम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, they cautiously came out and met together. Those heroes then again proceeded towards the Gandhamadana mountain.

sa: तस्मिन् क्षणेऽथ प्रववौ मारुतो भृशदारुणः। रजसा संवृतं तेन नष्टज्योतिरभून्नभः॥
en: At that time a violent wind began to blow and the sky became darkened with the dust that covered it.

sa: तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत नागतीर्थे नराधिप। कपिलानां सहस्रस्य फलं विन्दति मानवः॥
en: O ruler of men, bathing in the Naga-Tirtha, a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand Kapila kine.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अत्यद्भुतमिदं ब्रह्मन् धर्माख्यानमनुत्तमम्। सर्वधर्मविदां श्रेष्ठ कथितं मुनिसत्तम॥
en: Yudhishthira said: O foremost of all virtuous men, O best of Rishis, O Brahmana, wonderful is this excellent moral story.

sa: प्राप्तुमिच्छन्ति देवास्त्वां शक्रोऽग्निर्वरुणो यमः। तेषामन्यतम् देवं पतित्वे वरयस्व ह॥
en: And the gods-Shakra, Agni, Vasava and Yama, all desire to win you. Hence choose one of them for your husband."

sa: आश्रमांश्च विचित्रांश्च नदीश्च विविधाः शुभाः। नगराणि समृद्धानि खेटान् जनपदांस्तथा॥
en: (He also saw) various hermitages and many auspicious rivers, prosperous towns, villages and rural regions, all enjoying plenty in everything.

sa: कथं ह्यहं प्रतिश्रुत्य देवतानां विशेषतः। परार्थे यत्नमारभ्य कथं स्वार्थमिहोत्सहे॥
en: Having promised the celestials specially and come in their interest, how can I venture to look to my own (interest).

sa: ततस्तैर्विहितः पूर्वं समङ्गो नाम बल्लवः। समीपस्थास्तदा गावो धृतराष्ट्र न्यवेदयत्॥
en: Then a cowherd named Samanga who had been instructed before-hand come to the king Dhritarashtra and spoke about the cattle.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौन्तेया भ्रातृभिः सह भारत। मार्कण्डेयं पर्यपृच्छधर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, having heard this, the son of Kunti Dharmaraja Yudhishthira with his brothers thus again asked Markandeya.

sa: सिंहिकातनयांश्चापि ये चान्ये सुरशत्रवः। यच्च किंचिन्मया लोके दृष्टं स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥
en: The son of Singhikas and all other enemies of the celestials. Whatever mobile and immobile things I saw on earth.

sa: आस्येनानुप्रविष्टोऽहं शरीरे भगवंस्तव। दृष्टवानखिलान् सर्वान् समस्तान् जठरे हि ते॥
en: O excellent one, having entered into your body through your mouth, I have seen the entire universe in your stomach.

sa: इह भूत्वा शिशुः साक्षात् किं भवानवतिष्ठते। पीत्वा जगदिदं सर्वमेतदाख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Why do you stay here becoming a boy and swallowing up the universe? You should explain to me all this.

sa: प्रलये चापि निर्वृत्ते प्रबुद्धे च पितामहे। त्वमेकः सृज्यमानानि भूतानीह प्रपश्यसि॥ चतुर्विधानि विप्रर्षे यथावत् परमेष्ठिना। वायुभूता दिशः कृत्वा विक्षिप्यापस्ततस्ततः॥
en: When that dissolution ceases and the grandsire awakes, you alone, O great Rishi, see the Parameshti (Brahma) duly recreate the four orders of beings after having filled the cardinal points with air and placed the waters in their proper places.

sa: पितामहश्च भगवान् देवैः सह महाद्युतिः। भृगु नियोजयामास याजनार्थे महाद्युतिम्॥
en: And the exalted and the greatly effulgent Grandsire, with the celestials appointed the greatly effulgent Bhrigu to perform their sacrifice.

sa: ततो विबुद्धे तस्मिंस्तु सर्वलोकपितामहे। एकीभूतो हि हरक्ष्यामि शरीराणि द्विजोत्तम॥ आकाशं पृथिवीं ज्योतिर्वायु सलिलमेव च। लोके यच्च भवेच्छेषमिह स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, when that Grandsire of all creatures will awake. I shall alone create all creatures having bodies, also the firmament, the earth, the light, the atmosphere, the water and also all mobile and immobile creatures on earth.

sa: तथा कथां शुभां श्रुत्वा मार्कण्डेयस्यधीमतः। विस्मिताः समपद्यन्त पुराणस्य निवेदनात्॥
en: Having heard the blessed words of the ancient history told by the intelligent Markandeya, they were (all) filled with astonishment.

sa: न त्वद्य शक्यमस्माभिरेतत् कर्तुमतोऽन्यथा। नूनं दैवकृतं ह्येतद् यदेवं कृतवानसि॥
en: It is impossible now to turn back the incident which happened. What you have done was certainly ordained by Fate,

sa: शुशुभे सा सभा राजन् राजभिस्तैः समागतः। देवैरिव महाभागैः समवेतैस्त्रिविष्टपम्॥
en: O king, that Assembly-hall looked beautiful with the assembled monarchs like the heaven with a conclave of greatly fortunate celestials.

sa: इदं चैवापरं भूयः सह भ्रातृभिरच्युत। धर्मसंशयमोक्षार्थं निबोध वचनं मम॥
en: O undeteriorating one, hear now my words with your brothers relating some thing else to clear your doubts about religion.

sa: ते तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय कृष्णया सह पाण्डवाः। कृतस्वस्त्ययनाः सर्वे मुनिभिर्दिव्यमानुषैः।।२१
en: Saying “So be it," the Pandavas with Krishna (Draupadi) caused all those celestials and human Rishis to perform propitiatory rites.

sa: स्यादयं ब्राह्मणः सोऽथ युष्माभिर्यो विनाशितः। पुत्रो ह्ययं मम नृपास्तपोबलसमन्वितः॥
en: "O kings, is this the Brahmana who was killed by you? He is indeed my son devoted to great austerities."

sa: ततस्तान्यल्पसारणि सत्त्वानि क्षुधितानि वै। प्रलयं यान्ति भूयिष्ठं पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपते॥
en: O lord of earth, then men and (other) creatures, possessing but little strength and vitality, die of starvation by thousands.

sa: द्रोणं कृपं नृपांश्चान्यानश्वत्थामानमेव च। विदुरं धृतराष्ट्रं च धार्तराष्ट्रांश्च सर्वशः॥
en: To Drona, to Kripa, to all the other kings, to Ashvathama, Vidura, Dhritarashtra, and to all the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: नायं युक्तः समाचार: पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु। यत् कामात् पुण्डरीकाक्षं पाण्डवार्चितवानसि॥
en: Your this conduct in willfully making this lotus-eyed hero worshipped by the Pandavas is not worthy of the illustrious Pandavas.

sa: अथ वा वासुदेवोऽपि प्रियकामोऽनुवृत्तवान्। दुपदे तिष्ठति कथं माधवोऽर्हति पूजनम्॥
en: If you consider him your well-wisher and supporter, why, when Drupada is here, how can he get the (first) worship?

sa: उपपन्नं च पाञ्चालि तवेदं वृत्तमीदृशम्। यत् कृच्छ्रमपि सम्प्राप्ता धर्ममेवान्ववेक्षसे॥
en: O Panchali, your this conduct, namely through persecuted, you still cast your eyes on Dharma, is certainly worthy of you.

sa: एतत् प्रकरणं राजन्नधिकृत्य युधिष्ठिर॥ पतिव्रतानां नियतं धर्मं चावहितः शृणु॥
en: O king, O Yudhishthira, remembering this fact, listen to the virtue of chaste women with as much attention as possible.

sa: विदुरश्चापि तामा" कुन्तीमाश्वास्य हेतुभिः। प्रावेशयद् गृहं क्षत्ता स्वयमार्ततरः शनैः॥
en: Vidura, himself greatly grieved, consoled the afflicted Kunti with reasons, and Khattwa (Vidura) then led her slowly to his house.

sa: भ्रातुः प्रियमभीप्सन् वै चकार सुमहद् वपुः। देहस्तस्य ततोऽतीव वर्धत्यायामविस्तरैः॥
en: Desiring to gratify his brother, he (Hanuman) assumed a gigantic body which both in length and breadth grew exceedingly huge.

sa: एतत् सर्वं यथावृत्तं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः। कर्मभिर्देवकल्पानां कीर्त्यमानै शं रमे॥
en: I desire to learn all this as they happened. I take delight in hearing the accounts of the celestials-like men.

sa: ततः सुह्मान् प्रसुह्मांश्च सपक्षानतिवीर्यवान्। विजित्य युधि कौन्तेयो मागधानभ्यधाद् बली॥ दण्डं च दण्डधारं च विजित्य पृथिवीपतीन्। तैरेव सहितैः सर्वैर्गिरिव्रजमुपाद्रवत्॥
en: Thereupon the greatly energetic and powerful hero, the son of Kunti (Bhima), vanquished the Suhamas and the Prasuhmas, winning over to his his side Danda and Dandadhara. Being accompanied by all other kings, the Pandava (Bhima) then marched towards Girivraja.

sa: यथातिमात्रं कौन्तेयः श्रिया परमया युतः। राजसूयमवाप्यैवं हरिचन्द्र इव प्रभुः॥
en: The son of Kunti (Yudhishthira), having completed the Rajasuya sacrifice, obtained the prosperity as was obtained by the lord Harishchandra.

sa: एवं तेषु नरावयेषु निर्यत्सु गजसाह्वयात्। अनभ्रे विद्युतश्चासन् भूमिश्च समकम्पत॥
en: At the departure of those foremost of men from Hastinapur, lightning flashed in the cloudless sky, earth began to tremble,

sa: तस्मिन् विनिहते वीरे दानवास्त्रस्तचेतसः। हाहाभूता दिशो जग्मुरर्दिता मम सायकैः॥
en: When that brave warrior was killed by my bow, the disheartened Danavas fled in all directions, exclaiming “Oh” and “Alas.”

sa: यद् ब्रूयादर्जुनः कृष्णं सर्वं कुर्यादसंशयम्। कृष्णो धनंजयस्यार्थे स्वर्गलोकमपि त्यजेत्॥
en: Whatever Arjuna may say Krishna is certain to accomplish. Krishna can abandon heaven itself for the sake of Dhananjaya (Arjuna).

sa: इतश्चतुर्दशे वर्षे महत् प्राप्यस्यथ वैशसम्। द्रोणस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा धृतराष्ट्रोऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: On the fourteenth year a great calamity will overwhelm you. (Vaishampayana said) Having heard the words of Drona, Dhritarashtra said.

sa: न खल्वासीत् पुनयुद्धं तस्य यक्षैर्द्विजोत्तम। कच्चित् समागमस्तेषामासीद् वैश्रवणस्य च॥
en: O, the most excellent of the Brahmanas, was there no other fight with the Yakshas? Did they meet with Vaisravana?

sa: आगमिष्यति बीभत्सुः पाञ्चालैः परिवारितः॥ तेषां मध्ये महेष्वासो भीमसेनो महाबलः।
en: Vivatsu (Arjuna) will certainly come back surrounded by the Panchala heroes. Among them, the great bowman and greatly powerful Bhimsena.

sa: कथं च राजपुत्री सा प्रवरा सर्वयोषिताम्। पतिव्रता महाभागा सततं सत्यवादिनी॥ वनवासमदुःखार्हा दारुणं प्रत्यपद्यत। एतदाचक्ष्व मे सर्वं विस्तरेण तपोधन॥
en: How did that foremost of all women, the royal princess (Draupadi), ever devoted to her husbands, greatly fortunate and truthful, undeserving of suffering misery, endure that painful exile in the forest? O great ascetic, tell me all this in detail.

sa: समाश्चतस्रोऽभिगताः शिवेन चरतां वने। कृतोद्देशः स बीभत्सु पञ्चमीमभितः समाम्॥
en: We have peacefully ranged in the forests these four years. It was arranged by Vivatsu that in the fifth year,

sa: आश्रमश्चैव पुण्याख्य: काश्यपस्य महात्मनः। ऋष्यशृङ्गः सुतो यस्य तपस्वी संयतेन्द्रियः॥
en: This is the hermitage belonging to the illustrious son of Kashyapa, whose son was the ascetic Rishyashringa of subdued passions.

sa: कृतवानपि वा वीरः साहसं साहसप्रियः। इमे ह्यकस्मादुत्पाता महासमरदर्शनाः॥ दर्शयन्तो भयं तीव्र प्रादुर्भूताः समन्ततः। तं तथावादिनं कृष्णा प्रत्युवाच मनस्विनी। प्रिया प्रियं चिकीर्षन्ती महिषी चारुहासिनी॥
en: Or has that hero who delights in daring deeds already achieved some great feat? These omens appear on all sides, indicating a great battle and portending some fearful danger.” When he said this, the intelligent Krishna, (Draupadi) of sweet smiles, his beloved wife, thus spoke to him to remove his anxiety.

sa: लोमश उवाच तेषां तदासीदुचितमिल्वलस्यैव भिक्षणम्। ततस्ते सहिता राजनिल्वलं समुपाद्रवन्॥
en: O king, the suggestion to beg wealth from Ilyala appeared to them proper; and they all then went to Ilvala.

sa: प्रत्युवाच ततोऽगस्त्यः प्रहसन्निल्वलं तदा। ईशं सुर विद्मस्त्वां वयं सर्वेधनेश्वरम्॥
en: Thereupon Agastya smilingly thus replied, "O Asura, we know you to be possessed of great power and also enormous wealth.

sa: ततस्तं समुपास्थाय कृत्या सृष्टा महात्मना। कमण्डलुं जहारास्य मोहयित्वेव भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the female whom the high-souled Rishi created robbed with her charms the sacred water-pot of Yavakrit.

sa: आचार्यो विदुरः क्षत्ता शममेव वदिष्यतः। कृपश्च संजयश्चैव शममेव वदिष्यतः॥
en: The preceptor and Vidura, (known as) Khattva both speak of peace; Kripa as well as Sanjaya also speak of peace.

sa: स प्राची दिशमास्थाय महतो गजयूथपान्। ददर्श पृथिवीं चिट्ठीमस्य परिचिछिताम्॥
en: In the west he found many powerful leaders of elephant (killed) and saw the ground impressed with Bhima's (foot) prints.

sa: भृगुर्यत्र तपस्तेपे महर्षिगणसेविते। राजन् स आश्रमः ख्यातो भृगुतुङ्गो महागिरिः॥
en: And where Bhrigu practised his austerities. O king that hermitage has thus become known by the name of mountain Bhrigutunga.

sa: स्कन्द उवाच यावत् घोडश वर्षाणि भवन्ति तरुणाः प्रजाः। प्रबाधत मनुष्याणां तावद्रूपैः पृथग्विधैः॥ अहं च वः प्रदास्यामि रौद्रमात्मानमव्ययम्। परमं तेन सहिताः सुखं वत्स्यथ पूजिताः॥
en: Skanda said: So long the children of the human race do not attain the youthful state in their sixteenth year, you will afflict them inyour various forms. I shall bestow on you a fearful and inexhaustible spirit; with this you shall live happily and you shall also be worshipped by all.

sa: ततस्तदर्थं यतते कर्म चारभते महत्। इष्टानां रूपगन्धानामभ्यासं च निषेवते॥
en: For that end, they labour and perform great works and indulge in their much desired pleasures of beauty, of flavour.

sa: धनिष्ठादिस्तदा कालो ब्रह्मणा परिकल्पितः। रोहिणी ह्यभवत् पूर्वमेवं संख्या समाभवत्॥
en: Dhanishtha and other constellations were created by Brahma. Rohini was one of them and with her their number was full."

sa: कथं भोजस्य पुरुषे वर्गपाले दुरात्मनि। समावेशयसे सर्वं जगत् केवलकाम्यया॥
en: How can you from your desire alone establish the whole universe in this wicked minded slave and cow-heard of Vraja.

sa: तमृते ते नरव्याघ्राः पाण्डवा जनमेजय। मुदमप्राप्नुवन्तो वै काम्यके न्यवसंस्तदा॥
en: O Janamejaya, in his absence, those foremost of men, the Pandavas, continued to live in the Kamyaka in great cheerlessness.

sa: दह्यमानेन तु हृदा शरणार्थी महावने। ब्राह्मणान् विविधज्ञानान् पर्यपृच्छद् युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Thus burning in grief, Yudhishthira sought consolation in the great forest and talked with the Brahmanas learned in all Shastras.

sa: भवान्धर्मोधर्म इति सततं व्रतकर्शितः। कच्चिद् राजन् न निर्वेदादापन्नः क्लीबजीविकाम्।।
en: Afflicted with your vow you always cry, "Virtue, virtue."O king, have you from despair become a man of no manliness?

sa: तेन शब्देन सहसा समुद्रे पर्वतोपमाः। आप्लवन्त गतैः सत्त्वैर्मत्स्याः शतसहस्रशः॥
en: Stupefied at those sounds, hundreds and thousands of fishes (huge) as mountains began suddenly to fly away from the sea.

sa: द्वाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां बलवान् गृहीत्वा शङ्खमुत्तमम्। प्राध्यापयत भूतानां त्रासनं बलिनामपि॥
en: Holding an excellent conch in two of his hands, that mighty one blew it, frightening even the most powerful creatures.

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते वीरे शाल्वराजे विचेतसि। सम्प्राद्रवन् दानवेन्द्रा दारयन्तो वसुंधराम्॥
en: When the heroic king Shalva fell down senseless, all the chief Danavas rending the earth beneath their feet fled away.

sa: कृतार्थं चावगच्छामि परमात्मानमाहवे। शत्रूश्च विजितान् सर्वान् निर्वृत्तं च प्रयोजनम्॥
en: I consider myself greatly blessed; I have already vanquished all my enemies in battle and my object has been accomplished.”

sa: शालिहोत्रोऽथ किं नु स्याद्धयानां कुलतत्त्ववित्। मानुषं समनुप्राप्तो वपुः परमशोभनम्॥
en: Is he not Salihotra, who is conversant with the knowledge of horses? Or Salihotra has taken this beautiful human form?"

sa: ततः पर्यपतन्नुग्रा निवातकवचा मयि। तानहं विवरं दृष्ट्वा प्राहिण्वं यमसादनम्॥
en: Then the furious Nivatakavachas flew towards me. Seizing this opportunity, I began to send them to the abode of Yama.

sa: पश्य दिव्यं सुरुचिरं भीम पुष्पमनुत्तमम्। गन्धसंस्थानसम्पन्नं मनसो मम नन्दनम्॥
en: Draupadi said: "O Bhima, behold this beautiful and excellent celestials flower, it has gladdened my heart by its sweet fragrance.

sa: स समाप्यायितः शक्रो विष्णुना दैवतैः सह। ऋषिभिश्च महाभागैर्बलवान् समपद्यता॥
en: Thus favoured by Vishnu by all the celestials and by the highly-blessed Rishis Sakra (Indra) became more powerful than before.

sa: घृताची मेनका रम्भा पूर्वचित्तिः स्वयंप्रभा। उर्वशी मिश्रकेशी च दण्डगौरी वरूथिनी॥ गोपाली सहजन्या च कुम्भयोनिः प्रजागरा। चित्रसेना चित्रलेखा सहा च मधुरस्वरा॥ एताश्चान्याश्च ननृतुस्तत्र तत्र सहस्रशः। चित्तप्रसादने युक्ताः सिद्धानां पद्मलोचनाः॥ महाकटितटश्रोण्यः कम्पमानैः पयोधरैः। कटाक्षहावमाधुर्यैश्चेतोबुद्धिमनोहरैः॥
en: Ghritachi, Menaka, Rambha, Purvachithi, Sayamprabha, Urvashi, Misrakeshi, Dandagauri, Varuthini, Gopali, Sahajanya, Kumbhayoni, Prajagara, Chitrasena, Chitralekha, Saha, Saha, Madhurasvara, these and thousands of others having lotus-eyes, engaged in captivating the minds of the sages of accomplished piety, danced there. Having slim waists and fair, large hips they began to make various gestures shaking their breasts, casting their side-long looks and displaying other motions capable of captivating heart and mind of the spectators.

sa: एभिस्तदा मया वीर संग्रामे तारकामये। दैतेयानां सहस्राणि संयतानि महात्मनाम्॥
en: O hero, in the battle on account of Taraka, with these (weapons) thousands of powerful Daityas were bound by me.

sa: सुभद्रां द्रौपदीं चैव सभाजयत केशवः। निष्क्रम्यान्तःपुरात् तस्माद् युधिष्ठिर सहायवान्॥
en: Keshava (Krishna) then bade farewell to Subhadra and Draupadi. Then he came out of the inner apartments accompanied by Yudhishthira.

sa: आष्टिषेण उवाच अभक्षा वायुभक्षाश्च प्लवमाना विहायसा। जुषन्ते पर्वतश्रेष्ठमृषयः पर्वसंधिषु॥
en: Arstisena said: During the Parvas, sages living on air and water visit this prince of mountains, ranging through the skies.

sa: एको दुर्योधनो राजा शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः। तस्यां सभायां दिव्यायामूषतुस्तौ नरर्षभौ॥
en: King Duryodhana and the son of Subala, Shakuni, these two best of men only remained in that celestials Sabha (assembly-hall).

sa: अभिपद्य च बाहुभ्यां प्रत्यगृहणादमर्षितः। मातङ्गमिव मातङ्गः प्रभिन्नकरटामुखम्॥ स चाप्येनं ततो रक्षः प्रतिजग्राह वीर्यवान्। तमाक्षिपद् भीमसेनो बलेन बलिनां वरः॥
en: Inflamed with wrath, Bhima seized the Rakshasas by his arms as one elephant in rut seizes another. The mighty Rakshasas also in his turn seized his adversary, but that foremost of all warriors Bhimasena threw the cannibal down with violence.

sa: महामखेष्वाङ्गिरसी दीप्तिमत्सु महामते। महामतीति विख्याता सप्तमी कथ्यते सुता।॥ यां तु दृष्ट्वा भगवतीं जनः कुहुकुहायते। एकानशेति तामाहुः कुहूमङ्गिरसः सुताम्॥
en: O high-minded one, his seventh daughter was named Mahamati; she was always present at sacrifices of great splendour and that adorable daughter of Angiras whom they called matchless and about whom me cried kuhu, kuhu, in wonder was called Kuhu.

sa: राजानो हि महात्मानो योनिकर्मविशोधिताः। उद्धरन्ति प्रजाः सर्वास्तप आस्थाय पुष्कलम्॥
en: All illustrious kings of noble birth and great deeds are known to have delivered their people by practising high asceticism.

sa: केचिदत्र महेष्वासाः शूराः परमहर्षिताः। मार्गमाणाः परं यत्नं दानवानां प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: Those among them who were bow-men and heroes cheerfully went out and took great trouble of find out the Danavas.

sa: चोदितो वासुदेवेन भीमसेनो महाबलः॥ अवप्लुत्य रथात् तूर्णं बाहुभ्यां समवारयत्।
en: The mighty Bhima urged by Vasudeva, quickly jumped down from his chariot and caught hold of him by the arms.

sa: रामेण भाषिते वाक्ये बाष्पव्याकुलितेन्द्रियः। लक्ष्मणस्त्वरितः प्रायात्स्वगृहं न विवेश ह॥
en: Răma saying this, Lakşmaņa did not go to his own house, but with eyes full of tears specially repaired therefrom.

sa: अथैनां दुष्कृतां पूजां शिशुपालो व्यवस्यति। दुष्कृतायां यथान्यायं तथायं कर्तुमर्हति॥
en: If Shishupala considers this worship undeserved, in this undeserved worship he should do that which is proper in this matter

sa: अधिज्यं बलवत् कृत्वा व्याक्षिपन् सुमहद् धनुः॥ स सौबलमभिदुत्य गार्धपत्रैः शिलाशितैः। भृशमभ्यहनत् क्रुद्धस्तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपम्॥ उवाच चैनं मेधावी विगृह्य स्मारयन्निव।
en: Stringing his formidable bow and drawing it vehemently Sahadeva, in rage, pursued the son of Suvala and struck him with many arrows winged with vulturine feathers and whetted on stone, like a person striking a powerful elephant with pointed lances.

sa: वृष्णयो निखिलाश्चान्ये समाजग्मुर्महारथाः। एते चान्ये च बहवो राजानो मध्यदेशजाः॥
en: And numerous other Vrishnis, all great car-warriors, came to that sacrifice. These and many other kings of the middle country

sa: यस्त्वस्य विहितो घातस्तं करिष्यामि भारत। प्रधानवध एवास्य विनाशस्तं करोम्यहम्॥
en: I will bring about the destruction of the enemy, O Bharata. By killing the head of this encompass their destruction.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु हनूमांस्तौ वीरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ। वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकुशल: पुनर्नोवाच किंचन॥
en: Having addressed thus those two heroes-Rama and Laksmana, Hanuman, conversant with words and skilled in speech, did not speak again.

sa: वृषादर्भिश्च राजर्षी रत्नानि विविधानि च। रम्यांश्चावसथान् दत्त्वा द्विजेभ्यो दिवमागतः॥
