en: The Royal Sage Vrishadarvi went to the celestial region by making gifts of various jewels and beautiful houses to Brahmanas,

sa: तेषामापततां तत्र शरवर्षाणि मुञ्चताम्। अर्जुनो व्यधमत् सैन्यं महावातो घनामिव॥
en: With a heavy down-pour of arrows they advanced towards him, but Arjuna dispersed them like vapours before the gushing wind.

sa: एष ध्वजाये पार्थस्य प्रेक्षणीयः समन्ततः। दृश्यते वानरो भीमो द्विषतामघवर्धनः॥
en: On the top of Partha's banner a dreadful monkey is being seen capable of increasing the anger of the enemies.

sa: तदस्मिन्क्रियतां यत्नः क्षिप्रं पुरुषपुङ्गव। पुरा वानरसैन्यानि क्षयं नयति सायकैः॥
en: Therefore, O best of persons, do you endeavour your best. This one with his shafts slaughter the monkey-hosts before (us).

sa: एष तावदभिप्रायमाख्यातु स्वं महामतिः। यदस्य रुचिरं कर्तुं तत् कुरुध्वमतन्द्रिताः॥
en: Let the high-minded (Krishna) speak out what he proposes to do. Accomplish with all alacrity what he desires to do."

sa: एते रुवन्ति मधुरं सारसा जलचारिणः। ध्रुवमत्र जलस्थानं महच्चेति मतिर्मम॥
en: I hear the sweet notes of the water fowl Sarashas. I think there must be a big lake (somewhere here)."

sa: स्थिरां कृत्वा बुद्धिमस्य प्रियाण्युक्त्वा च भारत। गम्यतामित्यनुज्ञाय जयमाप्नुहि चेत्यथ॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, cheering his mind by soft speeches, they permitted him to depart saying, “Go and attain victory."

sa: ततो गृहीत्वा वासस्तु शुभान्याभरणानि च। अभवद् वाष्पसंरुद्धो नीहारेणेव चन्द्रमाः॥
en: Taking the sheet and the ornaments, (Rama) had his ayes filled with tears, like the moon covered by the dew.

sa: अवप्लुत्य महावेगः प्रहस्तस्य निवेशनम्। अग्नि तत्र विनिक्षिप्य श्वसनेन समो वली॥ ततोऽन्यत् पुप्लुवे वेश्म महापार्श्वस्य वीर्यवान्। मुमोच हनुमानग्नि कालानलशिखोपमम्॥
en: And that one gifted with exceeding vehemence, and in strength resembling the Wind, bounding up set fire to the dwelling of Prahasta. Then Hanuman endowed with prowess, leaping up, set to Mahaparsva's mansion fire resembling that at the universal dissolution.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय शकुनिर्युद्धदुर्मदः। विव्याध नकुलं षष्ट्या भीमसेनं च सप्तभिः॥
en: Invincible in battle, Shakuni, however, took up another bow and struck Nakula with sixty arrows and then Bhimasena with seven.

sa: एतेन नियमेनासीद् वर्षाण्यष्टादशैव तु। पूर्णे त्वष्टादशे वर्षे सावित्री तुष्टिमभ्यगात्॥
en: He observed (all) these vows for eighteen years and when the eighteenth year was complete, Savitri was pleased with him.

sa: आदित्यश्चन्द्रमाश्चैव नक्षत्राणि ग्रहाश्च ये। दिशश्च विदिशश्चैव सर्वं कृष्णे प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
en: The sun, the moon, the stars, the planets, the chief directions and the intermediate directions are all established in Krishna.

sa: वरं वृणीष्वाश्वपते मद्रराज यदीप्सितम्। न प्रमादश्च धर्मेषु कर्तव्यस्ते कथञ्चन॥
en: O Ashvapati, O king of Madra, ask for whatever boon you desire. You should, however by no means disrespect virtue.

sa: इत्येवं चिन्तयामास सुतस्नेहावृता पृथा। ततः सुप्तजनप्राये दुर्दिने मेघसम्प्लुते॥ महत्यथापराहणे तु घनैः सूर्य इवावृतः। ब्राह्मणैः प्राविशत् तत्र जिष्णुर्भार्गववेश्म तत्॥
en: Thus Pondered Pritha out of her affection for her children. Then in the stillness of the late afternoon, Jishnu (Arjuna), accompanied with many Brahmanas, entered the potter's house like the cloud-covered sun emerged from the clouds in a cloudy day.

sa: दूतवाक्यं तु तच्छ्रुत्वा राजा परमहर्षितः। वसिष्ठं वामदेवं च मन्त्रिणश्चैवमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing the words of the envoys, the king, exceedingly rejoiced, addressed Vasiştha and Vamadeva, as well as his counsellors, saying,

sa: अभिगम्य तु तं देशं ददृशुभीमविक्रमाः। कृत्स्नं लोकस्य महतः प्रतिबिम्बमवस्थितम्॥
en: Coming to that country, these ones processing dreadful prowess, beheld (the sea) reflecting the image of this entire mighty world.

sa: न कथंचन कौरव्य प्रहर्तव्यं गुराविति। तदिदं वचनं साधोराचार्यस्य महात्मनः॥
en: "O scion of Kuru's race, on no account strike thy preceptor.” (But, those words of my virtuous and high-souled preceptor).

sa: एष संशप्तकाहूतस्तानेवाभिमुखो गतः। करोति कदनं चैषां संग्रामे द्विषतां बली॥
en: Challenged by Samsaptakas Partha proceeds against them; the powerful warrior is making a great havoc of his enemies in battle.

sa: परश्वधहतस्याद्य मन्दप्राणस्य भूतले। रामस्य रुधिरं रक्तमुष्णं पास्यसि राक्षसि ॥
en: You shall O Rākşasī, quaff on the ground the hot blood of Rāma of evil life, slain by my axe.

sa: पुत्रं तु निहतं दृष्ट्वा शकुनिस्तत्र भारत॥ साश्रुकण्ठो विनिःश्वस्य क्षत्तुर्वाक्यमनुस्मरन्।
en: Seeing his son slain, Shakuni, O Bharata, with voice suppressed in tears and sighing heavily, recollected the words of Vidura.

sa: एवमुक्तः स धर्मात्मा जनकेन महात्मना। प्रत्युवाच मुनिश्रेष्ठो वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः॥
en: Thus addressed by the high-souled Janaka, that first of ascetics endowed with a righteous soul, well versed in speech, answered,

sa: तं प्रहारमसम्भ्रान्तो लाघवेन महाबलः॥ मोघं दुर्योधनश्चक्रे तत्राभूद् विस्मयो महान्।
en: The powerful and fearless Duryodhana prevented that blow by his activity. Seeing this the spectators were filled with great wonder.

sa: हत्वा तत् पुरुषानीकं पञ्चालानां महारथः। भीमसेनं पुरस्कृत्य नचिरात् प्रत्यदृश्यत॥
en: Then that mighty car-warriors amongst the Panchalas, viz., Dhrishtadyumna with Bhimasena at the head quickly killed them and gained victory.

sa: विराटो द्रुपदश्चैव याज्ञसेनिश्च पञ्चभिः। शिखण्डी चैव हार्दिक्यं विद्धवा पञ्चभिराशुगैः॥
en: Virata, Drupada and Yajnaseni each pierced him with five shafts, Sikhandin also pierced Hridika's son with five swift flying arrows.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच तस्मिञ्जाते महासत्त्वे महासेने महाबले। समुत्तस्थुर्महोत्पाता घोररूपाः पृथग्विधाः॥
en: Markandey said : When that powerful, mighty and high-souled one (Mahasena) was born, various kinds of fearful evil omens appeared.

sa: ततोऽपरेण भल्लेन हृद्येनं समताडयत्। स युद्धे युयुधानेन हताश्वो हतसारथिः॥
en: Deprived of his horses and driver in that battle by Yuyudhana, skilled in weapons, Kritavarınan came down on the Earth.

sa: प्रजानां समुदाचारं बहु कर्म कृतं वदन। छादयिष्यामि कौन्तेय माययाऽऽत्मानमात्मना॥
en: And in reciting various good deeds and customs of people, I shall, O son of Kunti, conceal myself in disguise.

sa: अवस्थानं यदैव त्वमासिष्यसि परंतप। तदैव हरयः सर्वे त्यक्ष्यन्ति कृतनिश्चयाः॥
en: O subduer of enemies, soon as you shall set up here, the monkeys, making up their minds, shall forsake you.

sa: ततो ववौ महाराज मारुतो लोमहर्षणः। राहुरग्रसदादित्यं युगपत् सोममेव च॥
en: Then, O king, a terrible wind began to blow, and Rahu swallowed up both the Sun and the Moon simultaneously.

sa: अग्रतो मे कृता राजा छिन्नसर्वपरिच्छदः॥ दुर्योधन प्रीत्यर्थं राधेयेन दुरात्मना।
en: Before my very eyes the wicked son of Radha cut-off the king's armnour and robes for the gratification of Duryodhana.

sa: त्रिषु लोकेषु तावच्च वैशिष्ट्यं प्रतिपत्स्यसे। सुप्रियः सर्वलोकस्य भविष्यसि जनार्दन॥
en: Indeed, your distinction will last so long in the three worlds. O Janardana, agreeable you will be to all persons.

sa: स तु तेन तदा क्रोधात्काकुत्स्थेनादितो भृशम्। रावणः समरश्लाघी महाक्रोधमुपागमत्॥
en: On being greatly harassed by Käkutstha in anger, Ravana, delighting in battle, came under the sway of a towering passion.

sa: दुश्चरं सर्वलोकेऽस्मिन् सत्त्वं प्रति समाश्रितम्! एतदेव हि लोकेऽस्मिन् कालचक्र प्रवर्तते॥ एतन्महार्णवं घोरमगाधं मोहसंज्ञितम्। विक्षिपेत् संक्षिपेच्चैव बोधयेत् सामरं जगत्॥
en: It is difficult of being moved in this mortal world, and it rests on the understanding as its stay. That body is, in called delusion. It is this body which stretches forth, contracts, and awakens the universe with the immortals.

sa: द्रष्टव्यौ नित्यमेवैतो तत्परेणान्तरात्मना। तथास्य जन्मनिधने न भवेतां पुनः पुनः॥
en: One should, with devoted attention, think on both Nature and Soul, so that he may avoid repeated birth and death.

sa: सादितं तु रथोपस्थे दृष्ट्वा पार्थाः शिखण्डिनम्। परिव्रवू रथैस्तूर्णं कृतवर्माणमाहवे॥
en: Beholding Sikhandin overthrown on the terrace of his car, the Parthas in that battle quickly surrounded Kritavarman with their chariots.

sa: यद्धि न्याय्यं मया कर्तुं तत्करिष्याम्यसंशयम्। भूत्वा पर्वतसंकाशो नाशयिष्यामि राक्षसम्।७४।।
en: I will doubtless do as befits me now let me assume the shape of a mountain and kill the Raksasas.

sa: अर्श्वबाहुश्चतुर्थं तु मासमस्मि स्थितस्तदा। न च मे हीयते प्राणस्तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: In the fourth month I remained with upraised arms; and it is a wonder that my strength did not diminish.

sa: वध्यमाना महाराज पाण्डवाः सृञ्जयास्तथा। त्रातारं नाध्यगच्छन्त पङ्कमग्ना इव द्विपाः॥
en: Slaughtered (ruthlessly), the Pandava and the Srinjayas, O mighty monarch, could not find a protector, like elephants sunk in mire.

sa: भवत्यधर्मो धर्मो हि धर्माधर्मावुभावपि। कारणाद् देशकालस्य देशकालः स तादृशः॥
en: Righteousness becomes unrighteousness, and unrighteousness becomes righteousness, according to place and time, Such is the power of place and time.

sa: विष्णुश्च भगवान् देवः सर्वलोकाभिपूजितः॥ ऐन्द्रं समाविशद् वज्रं लोकसंरक्षणे रतः।
en: The illustrious and divine Vishnu, worshipped of all the worlds, bent upon protecting the universe, entered the thunderbolt of Indra.

sa: तन्मां सुरवराः सर्वे सर्षिसङ्घाः सचारणाः। सुरकार्यकरं यूयं सफलं कर्तुमर्हथ॥
en: And, therefore, you celestials, and saints, and Cāraņas, you should restore my scrotum to me who have served the gods.'

sa: तं चक्ररक्षौ पाञ्चाल्यौ युधामन्यूत्तमौजसौ। अन्वयातां महात्मानौ विशन्तं तावकं बलम्॥
en: And when he penetrated into your army, the two illustrious Panchala princes, Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas, followed him, protecting his car-wheel.

sa: युद्धार्थी वासिताहेतोर्गजः प्रतिगजं यथा। भीमसेनं ययौ शल्य मद्राणामीश्वरो बली॥
en: The mighty! king of the Madras, Shalya rushed against. Bhima like one elephant rushing against another for a female one.

sa: चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः। बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव॥
en: Mentally dedicating all actions to Me, restoring to mental abstraction, being devoted to Me, fix your thoughts constantly on Me.

sa: यत्र रामो महाभागो भार्गवः सुमहातपाः॥ असकृत् पृथिवीं जित्वा हतक्षत्रियपुङ्गवाम्।
en: The highly blessed and ascetic Rama of Bhrigu's race, repeatedly conquered the Earth and killed all the foremost of Kshatriyas.

sa: जामदग्न्यश्च विप्राय भूमिं दत्त्वा महायशाः। रामोऽक्षयांस्तथा लोकान् जगाम मनसोऽधिकान्॥१२
en: The illustrious Rama, the son of Jamadagni, acquired the eternal regions, far beyond his expectation by giving lands to Brahmanas.

sa: क्रयविक्रयकाले च सर्वः सर्वस्य वञ्चनम्। युगान्ते भरतश्रेष्ठ वित्तलोभात् करिष्यति॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, led by avarice, men will deceive one another when they will buy and sell.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता शत्रुणा शत्रुकर्शनः॥ निपपात तदा भूमौ किंचित्प्राणो नराधिपः।
en: Being thus afflicted by his powerful assailant, that destroyer of enemies, O king, dropped down on the Earth almost dead.

sa: यत् त्वयोक्तं विनष्टानामिदमश्रुप्रमार्जनम्। राक्षसानां करोमीति मिथ्या तदपि ते वचः॥
en: And what you had said, will wipe the tears of the Rākşasas that have been slain, has also proved false.

sa: आनीय च वनात्सीतां पद्महीनामिव श्रियम्। किमर्थं प्रतिदास्यामि राघवस्य भयादहम्।।
en: Why, having brought Sītā like a Sri shorn of her lotus, shall I give her up, from fear of Rāghava?

sa: म्लेच्छभूतं जगत् सर्वं भविष्यति युधिष्ठिर। न श्राद्धैस्तर्पयिष्यन्ति दैवतानीह मानवाः॥
en: O Yudhishthira, the whole world will be then Mlechchhafied; men will no more gratify the celestials performing the Shraddha ceremony.

sa: तामेव मनसा रामां मयूरोऽप्यनुधावति ॥ वितत्य रुचिरौ पक्षौ रुतैरुपहसन्निव।
en: The peacock unfolding his charming wings is moving after his dear mate mocking me as if were with his cry.

sa: स गत्वा दूरमध्वानं वसिष्ठाश्रममभ्ययात्॥ तस्य ते सैनिका राजंश्चक्रुस्तत्रानयान् बहून्।
en: Having proceeded far on his way, he reached the hermitage of Vashishtha. His troops, O king, caused immense mischief there.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तदा राजंस्तेऽभ्यवर्तन्त संयुगे। आट्ठयन्तोऽर्जुनं वीराः पितृजुष्टां दिशं प्रति॥
en: O monarch, having thus spoken, they then proceeded to the fight summoning Arjuna to the southern part of the field.

sa: दृष्ट्वाऽऽयान्तं तमतिथिं स च राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥ जगामाभिमुखः श्रीमान् सह भ्रातृभिरच्युतः। तस्मै बद्धवाञ्जलिं सम्यगुपवेश्य वरासने॥ विधिवत् पूजयित्वा तमातिथ्येन न्यमन्त्रयत्। आह्निकं भगवन् कृत्वा शीघ्रमेहीति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Beholding that guest arrive there the king Yudhishthira graceful and honest, proceeded with his brothers. Joining his hands and making him sit on an excellent seat. And adoring him duly he treated him with hospitalicy. He said, “Come back soon, O venerably sir, after performing your ablutions and reciting your prayers."

sa: अश्वत्थामा सोमदत्तश्चावत्यौ च महारथौ। महत्या सेनया युक्ता वामं पक्षमपालयन्॥
en: Ashvathama, Somadatta, and the two princes of Avanti, both mighty car-warriors, supported by a large division, defended the left wing.

sa: इतरास्तु स्त्रियः सर्वाः कुन्त्या सह सुदुःखिताः। नेत्रैरागतविक्लेदैः परिवार्य स्थिताऽभवन्॥
en: The other ladies, Kunti among them, became greatly afflicted. They wept, shedding profuse tears, and sat surrounding the old king.

sa: दृष्ट्वैवाभिपतन्तं तं शूरः परपुरंजयः। उवाज सूतं शैनेयः प्रहसन् युद्धदुर्मदः॥
en: Make towards himself, that subjugator of hostile towns, the invincible and heroic grandson of Sini, smilingly addressing his charioteer said

sa: तं स गोमायुरालोक्य स्नेहादागतसम्भ्रमम्। उवाच प्रणतो वाक्यं बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा॥
en: Seeing his master moved with affection, the jackal bowed down to him, and, in a voice suppressed with tears, said

sa: अभिषिक्तस्तु काकुत्स्थो बभौ चादित्यसंनिभः॥ अभिषिक्तः पुरा स्कन्दः सेन्ट्रैरिव दिवौकसैः।
en: And on being installed Käkutstha resembled the sun; and he like Skanda formerly installed by the celestials led by Indra.

sa: तस्य भीमो महावेगां जाम्बूनदपरिष्कृताम्॥ अतिक्रुद्धस्य क्रुद्धस्तु ताडयामास तां गदाम्।
en: Worked up with wrath Bhima struck the mace, endued with great impetuosity and adorned with gold, of the angry Duryodhana.

sa: तस्मिन् द्रोणेन निहताः पञ्चालाः पञ्चविंशतिः। महारथाः समाख्याता धृष्टद्युम्नस्य सम्मताः॥
en: In that battle were slain twenty-five best Panchala heroes, all reckoned among Maharathas and all enjoying the favour of Dhrishtadyumna.

sa: अथ तद्वाक्यमाकर्ण्य राजा चण्डालतां गतः॥ अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यकोविदम्।
en: Hearing him, the king conversant with words, fallen into Candāla-hood, with folded hands, said to that one versed in speech.

sa: अथ तानब्रवीत् सर्वान् विश्रान्तान् हरियूथपान्। इदं वचनमेकाना तापसी धर्मचारिणी॥
en: Then to all the monkey-chiefs, after they had rested, the female ascetic, engaged in righteous practices, eagerly said these words,

sa: व्यक्तं रामस्य विज्ञाय शौचं माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्। न गात्रमंशुभिः सूर्यः संतापयितुमर्हति॥
en: Acquainted with Rāma's manifest purity and high magnanimity, the Sun himself will not dare burn his body with his rays.

sa: इमाः प्रकृतयः सर्वा विधवा मातरश्च याः। त्वत्सकाशमनुप्राप्ताः प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि।९।।
en: All these subjects and our widowed mothers have come to you. It behoves you to show your favour to them.

sa: सखीवच्च विगाहस्व सीते मन्दाकिनी नदीम्। कमलान्यवमज्जन्ती पुष्कराणि च भामिनि॥
en: Do you, O Sītā, perform your ablutions in the Mandākinī, scattering at the sometime, O girl, red and white lotuses.

sa: विश्वामित्राभ्यनुज्ञातः सह सर्वैर्महर्षिभिः॥ एष वक्ष्यति धर्मात्मा वसिष्ठो में यथाक्रमम्।
en: And permitted by Viśvāmitra along with all the Maharsis, even this one of a righteous soul will relate my genealogy.

sa: एवमुक्ते तु वचने शतानन्दस्य संनिधौ। आगताः केचिदव्यग्रा जनकस्तान् समादिशत्॥
en: This having been said to Satānanda, some competent persons presented themselves; and Janaka commanded them (to set up) for Sāņkāśyā.

sa: कथं नु मयि धर्मेण पृथिवीमनुशासति। भवन्तो द्रष्टुमिच्छन्ति युवराजं महाबलम्॥
en: Why, while I am righteously governing the earth, do you wish to see the highly powerful Rāma as the heir-apparent?

sa: तासां रामः समुत्थाय जग्राह चरणाम्बुजान्। मातृणां मनुजव्याघ्रः सर्वासां सत्यसंगरः॥
en: Raising his mothers, that foremost of men, Rāma, true to his promise, took hold of those lotus feet of theirs.

sa: वचनाच्च नरेन्द्रस्य सेना च चतुरङ्गिणी। राजानमृषिभिः सार्धं व्रजन्तं पृष्ठतोऽन्वयात्॥
en: At these words of the king, the four-fold forces together with the saints went in the wake of the monarch.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा भूमिपालस्य वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः॥ आदिदेशाग्रतो राज्ञः स्थितान् युक्तान् कृताञ्जलीन्।
en: Hearing those words of the monarch, Vasistha, chief of anchorets, ordered the counsellors staying before the king with clasped hands.

sa: गुणा बहुविधाः प्राप्तास्तव संदर्शनान्मया। विस्तरेण च वै ब्रह्मन् कीर्त्यमानं महत्तपः॥ श्रुतं मया महातेजो रामेण च महात्मना। सदस्यैः प्राप्य च सदः श्रुतास्ते बहवो गुणाः॥
en: O mighty Muni. And from your sight have I received various qualities. O Brāhmaṇa, your mighty austerities have been related in detail; and myself as well as he high-souled Rāma have listened to the narration relative to your formidable ascetic energy; and the assembled courtiers have heard of your various perfections.

sa: विश्वामित्रोऽपि धर्मात्मा लब्ध्वा ब्राह्मण्यमुत्तमम्। पूजयामास ब्रह्मर्षि वसिष्ठं जपतां वरम्॥
en: And that Brahmarși, the righteous Viśvāmitra also, having attained excellent Brāhmaṇa-hood, paid his homage to that best of reciters, Vasistha.

sa: मुञ्चन्ति कुसुमान्येते नगाः पर्वतसानुषु। नीला इवातपापाये तोयं तोयधरा घनाः॥
en: And the trees scatter blossoms over the sides of the mountain, even as after summer sable clouds pour down showers.

sa: ततस्तं देशमागम्य सौम्या वितिमिरं वनम्॥ ददृशुः काञ्चनान् वृक्षान् दीप्तवैश्वानरप्रभान्।
en: Those mild ones, coming to a spot free from darkness, saw golden trees, possessed of the brightness of flaming fire.

sa: प्रवेक्ष्ये दण्डकारण्यमहमप्यविलम्बयन्। आभ्यां तु सहितो वीर वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च॥
en: I also, O hero, without delay shall have to enter the forest of Dandaka in company with Lakşmaņa and Sītā.

sa: चन्द्रार्कतरुणाभासां नियुक्तां शिबिकां शुभाम्। आस्थाय प्रययौ श्रीमान् भरतः सपरिच्छदः॥
en: And ascending an elegant car resembling the infant sun or moon, driven by charioteers, went the graceful Bharata well attired.

sa: एवंविधं कथयतां पौराणां शुश्रुवुः दिग्भ्यो विश्रुतवृत्तान्ताः प्राप्ता जानपदा जनाः॥
en: The inhabitants of the provinces, who having heard the tidings, had come from various regions, heard the citizens conversing thus.

sa: आश्वासयित्वा च चमूं महात्मा निवेशयित्वा च यथोपजोषम्। मृत्विक्सदस्यैर्भरतः प्रतस्थे॥ स ब्राह्मणस्याश्रममभ्युपेत्य महात्मनो देवपुरोहतस्य। ददर्श रम्योटजवृक्षदेशं महद्वनं विप्रवरस्य रम्यम्॥
en: Having made the army take rest at its ease, and encamped it (at the woods of Prayāga), that magnanimous one, Bharata, for the purpose of seeing the asylum of the ascetic Bharadvāja, went thither, accompanied by Rtvijas and Sadasyas (members).

sa: राजा च राघवौ पुत्रौ निशाम्य परिहर्षितः॥ उवास परमप्रीतो जनकेनाभिपूजितः।
en: And the king, overjoyed on beholding his sons, the Rāghavas passed (the night) in exceeding delight, splendidly entertained of Janaka.

sa: तारया वाक्यमुक्तोऽहं सत्यं सर्वज्ञया हितम्। तदतिक्रम्य मोहेन कालस्य वशमागतः॥
en: Alas! disregarding the well meaning and truthful words of Tārā, I have placed myself under the control of Kāla (Death).

sa: एवमुक्तो महातेजा ऋचीकस्त्वब्रवीद् वचः॥ नाहं ज्येष्ठं नरश्रेष्ठ विक्रीणीयां कथंचन।
en: Thus addressed the exceedingly energetic Rcīka replied, “O best of men, my first-born I will in no wise dispose of.'

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु अयोध्याधिपतिर्महान्। अम्बरीष इति ख्यातो यष्टुं समुपचक्रमे॥
en: And it came to pass that at this time that mighty lord of Ayodhyā, Ambarışa, prepared for celebrating a sacrifice.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजाः पुष्करेषु महामुनिः। तप उग्रं दुराधर्षं तेपे मूलफलाशनः॥
en: Having said this, that exceedingly energetic and mighty Muni (Ascetic) began to perform terrible austerities, subsisting on fruits and roots.

sa: स तु राममवेक्षन्तं सुमन्त्रं प्रेक्ष्य दुर्मनाः। कुशोत्तरमुपस्थाप्य भूमावेवास्थितः स्वयम्॥
en: Then with a dispirited heart finding Sumantra looking up to Rāma, Bharata himself spread Kuśa and lay down upon it.

sa: एवं ते ज्ञातिपक्षस्य श्रेयश्चैव भविष्यति। यदि चेद्भरतो धर्मात्पित्र्यं राज्यमवाप्स्यति॥
en: But if Bharata can get at his ancestral kingdom by just means, that would also be welcome to your kindred.

sa: ततो गत्वाऽऽश्रमपदं मुमोचास्त्राणि पार्थिवः। यैस्तत् तपोवनं नाम निर्दग्धं चास्त्रतेजसा॥
en: And repairing to Vasistha's asylum, the king began to discharge weapons; and by their energy the hermitage began to burn.

sa: ज्येष्ठः श्रेष्ठश्च धर्मात्मा दिलीपनहुषोपमः। लब्धुमर्हति काकुत्स्थो राज्यं दशरथो यथा॥
en: First-born, and foremost in merit, righteoussouled, and comparable to Dilipa and Nahuşa, Kākutstha deserves the kingdom, just as Dasaratha did.

sa: प्रहृष्टवदनः सर्वा मातृः समभिभाष्य च। आरुरोह रथं श्रीमाशत्रुघ्नेन समन्तितः॥
en: Then with a cheerful countenance having spoken to his mothers, that graceful one ascended the car in company with Satrughna.

sa: आरुह्य तु रथं क्षिप्रं शत्रुघ्नभरताबुभौ। ययतुः परमप्रीतौ वृतौ मन्त्रिपुरोहितैः॥
en: Having swiftly ascended the car, both Satrughna and Bharata, right glad at heart, set out surrounded by counsellors and priests.

sa: अप्रमेयं बलं तुभ्यं न त्वया बलवत्तरः। विश्वामित्रो महावीर्यस्तेजस्तव दुरासदम्॥
en: Your power is immeasurable; and the exceedingly energetic Viśvāmitra is not more one powerful than thyself. Your energy is unequalled.

sa: विसार्य सर्वतो दृष्टिं कानने काननप्रियः। सुग्रीवो विपुलग्रीवः क्रोधमाहारयद् भृशम्॥
en: Casting his looks all around in the forest, Sugrīva, having a huge neck and fond of woods, became exceedingly enraged.

sa: पितरि स्वर्गमापन्ने रामे चारण्यमाश्रिते। किं मे जीवितसामर्थ्य प्रवेक्ष्यामि हुताशनम्॥
en: My father having gone to heaven and Rāma having sought the woods, how can I live? I will enter fire.

sa: प्रजापतिसुतस्त्वासीत् कुशो नाम महीपतिः। कुशस्य पुत्रो बलवान् कुशनाभः सुधार्मिकः॥
en: And there was a king named Kuša, the son of Prajāpati. And Kuśa's son was the powerful and pious Kušanābha.

sa: तच्च दृष्ट्वा धनुःश्रेष्ठं गौरवाद् गिरिसंनिभम्। अभिवाद्य नृपा जग्मुरशक्तास्तस्य तोलने॥
en: Seeing that best of bows in weight resembling a hill, the kings saluting it, go away, unable to move it.

sa: अपि ते मुनिशार्दूल मम माता यशस्विनी। दर्शिता राजपुत्राय तपोदीर्घमुपागता॥
en: O most powerful of anchorets, by you was my illustrious mother, grown old in asceticism, shown to the king's son.

sa: गम्यतामनुजानामि रामस्यानुचरी भव। कथयन्त्या हि मधुरं त्वयाहमपि तोषिता ॥
en: Go you; I permit you. Do you seek the society of Rāma. I have been pleased with your sweet converse.

sa: ततः स शर्वरी प्रीतः पुण्यां शशिनिभाननाम्। अर्चितस्तापसैः सर्वैरुवास रघुनन्दनः॥
en: Then Raghu's son, ministered to by the ascetic, happily spent the delightful night there, with her face resembling the moon.

sa: एवं विलपमानस्य दुःखार्तस्य महात्मनः। मोहाच्च शोकसंरम्भाद् बभूव लुलितं मनः॥
en: And bewailing thus, the mind of the high souled (Bharata) wrought with sorrow, was overcome with the burden of grief.

sa: शृणु सर्वमशेषेण कथ्यमानं मया द्विज। शंसितुं तन्महान्हर्षो ममापीह प्रवर्तते॥
en: Listen to it in full, O Brahmana, as I recite it. I myself feel a great pleasure in reciting it.

sa: ते शरीरं विराधस्य भित्त्वा बर्हिणवाससः। निपेतुः शोणितादिग्धा धरण्यां पावकोपमाः॥
en: Thereat, resembling flames, those arrows furnished with peacocks, feathers, pierced. Viradha's body, and fell to the earth, covered with blood.

sa: चिरं खलु मया पापे त्वं पापेनाभिरक्षिता। अज्ञानादुपसम्पन्ना रज्जुरुद्वन्धनी यथा॥
en: Wretch as I am, like a halter set round one's neck, have I, O vile woman, cherished you through ignorance.

sa: विषाणयोर्गृहीत्वा तं दुन्दुभिं गिरिसंनिभम्। आविध्यत तथा वाली विनदन् कपिकुञ्जरः॥
en: Holding him by the horns, Vāli, that lord of monkeys, setting up a terrible roar, hurled Dundhubhi resembling a mountain.

sa: सिन्धुसागरयोश्चैव संगमे तत्र पर्वतः। महान् सोमगिरि म शतशृङ्गो महाद्रुमः॥ तत्र प्रस्थेषु रम्येषु सिंहा पक्षगमाः स्थिताः। तिमिमत्स्यगजांश्चैव नीडान्यारोपयन्ति ते॥
en: There is a mighty mountain where the Sindhu falls into the sea, Somagiri by name; having an hundred summits and tall trees. In its plateaus there are certain birds (called) Sinhas. These lift up to their nests whales and elephants.

sa: क्षिप्रं मामपि कैकेयी प्रस्थापयितुमर्हति। हिरण्यनाभो यत्रास्ते सुतो मे सुमहायशाः॥
en: It behoves Kaikeyi to send me also speedily to where is staying my illustrious son furnished with a gold-gleaming navel.

sa: ततः शत्रुघ्नभरतौ कौसल्या प्रेक्ष्य दुःखितौ। पर्यष्वजेतां दुःखार्ती पतितां नष्टचेतनाम्॥ रुदन्तौ रुदती दुःखात् समेत्यार्या मनस्विनी। भरतं प्रत्युवाचेदं कौसल्या भृशदुःखिता॥
en: Then Śatrughna and Bharata seeing the aggrieved Kausalyā, embraced the stricken and fallen lady wellnigh deprived of her senses. Thereupon, weeping from grief, the noble and intelligent Kausalyà exceedingly afflicted, embracing them as they indulged in sorrow, said to Bharata.

sa: पारिपल्वगताश्चापि देवतास्तत्र विष्ठिताः। तदद्भुतमिमं लोके गङ्गावतरमुत्तमम्॥ दिदृक्षवो देवगणाः समीयुरमितौजसः।
en: And the celestials stationed on cars were struck with surprise; and all creatures marvelled at the excellent descent of Gangā.

sa: ते तु तां रजनीमुष्य ब्राह्मणा वेदपारगाः। उपतस्थुरुपस्थानं सह राजपुरोहिताः॥ अमात्या बलमुख्याश्च मुख्या ये निगमस्य च। राघवस्याभिषेकार्थे प्रीयमाणाः सुसंगताः॥
en: The Brahmana, versed in in Veda, the counsellors, the commanders of military forces and the leading merchants, together with the royal priest, all brimming with joy on account of Rāma's installation, were waiting at the royal gate all night long

sa: तस्मै राज्यं समादिश्य दिलीपे रघुनन्दन। हिमवच्छिखरे रम्ये तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम्॥
en: O Raghu's son, consigning to Dilipa his kingdom, Ansumat entered upon rigid austerities on the romantic summit of the Himavat.

sa: मया तु वचनं श्रुत्वा तेषामेवं मुखाच्च्युतम्।।७ कृत्वा वचनशुश्रूषां वाक्यमेतदुदाहृतम्।
en: Hearing those words of theirs which fell from their lips, I, resolving to act in accordance with their request, said.

sa: अथवापि महाबाहुर्गतो दूरं भविष्यति। मामेव रथमारोप्य शीघ्रं रामाय दर्शय॥
en: But if that mighty-armed one has proceeded far, do you placing me on a car speedily show me to Rāma.

sa: यदा पर्वणि काकुत्स्थ विश्रमार्थं महागजः। खेदाच्चालयते शीर्ष भूमिकम्पस्तदा भवेत्॥
en: And, O Kākutstha, when on sacred days the mighty elephant, from fatigue, shake his head, then takes place the earthquake.

sa: भूयः खनत भद्रं वो विभेद्य वसुधातलम्। अश्वहर्तारमासाद्य कृतार्थाश्च निवर्तत॥
en: 'Do you yet again, good betide you, delve the earth, and having got at the stealer of the horse, cease.'

sa: ततः सुतीक्ष्णवचनं यथा सौम्य मया श्रुतम्। अगस्त्याश्रमो भ्रातुनमेष भविष्यति॥
en: O placid one, from what I had heard from Sutiksna, this would appear to be the asylum of Agastya's brother.

sa: इहैकदा किल कुरो वातापिरपि चेल्वलः। भ्रातरौ सहितावास्तां ब्राह्मणघ्नौ महासुरौ॥
en: Once on a time here dwelt together two mighty Asuras, brothers, given to slaughtering Brāhmanas, the wily Vātāpi and Ilvala.

sa: अपत्यलाभः सुमहान् भविष्यति तवानघ। कीर्ति चाप्रतिमां लोके प्राप्स्यसे पुरुषर्षभ।७।।
en: O sinless one, you shall obtain glorious offspring; and, O foremost of men, you shall attain unparalleled renown among Man.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महातेजाः समस्तं तद्वरायुधम्। दत्त्वा रामाय भगवानगस्त्यः पुनरब्रवीत् ॥
en: Having said this, that highly energetic one, the reverend Agastya, consigning to Rāma all those weapon, again said. SCCTION 13

sa: तौ तु तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातौ कृतपादाभिवन्दनौ। तमाश्रमं पञ्चवटी जग्मतुः सह सीतया॥
en: Then, having saluted his feet, they, taking the saint's permission, set out along with Sītā for the hermitage of Pañcavați.

sa: अपश्यन्ती तव मुखं परिपूर्णशशिप्रभम्। कृपणा वर्तयिष्यामि कथं कृपणजीविका ॥
en: How shall I, of miserable life, pass my days in grief not seeing your face, effulgent like to the full-moon.

sa: ततस्त्विरावतीं नाम जज्ञे भद्रमदा सुताम्। तस्यास्त्वैरावतः पुत्रो लोकनाथो महागजः॥
en: And Bhadramadā bore one daughter, Irāvati. And Irāvati's son is the mighty elephant; who is the lord of the worlds.

sa: विशेषेण भवानेव विश्वामित्र महायशः। कौशिकी सरितां श्रेष्ठा कुलोद्योतकरी तव॥
en: And specially you, O illustrious Viśvāmitra, art so. And that best of streams, Kausiki, has added lustre to your lien.

sa: सशल्यः क्लिश्यते प्राणैर्विशल्यो विनशिष्यति।४६।। इति मामविशच्चिन्ता तस्य शल्यापकर्षणे। दुःखितस्य च दीनस्य मम शोकातुरस्य च॥ लक्षयामास स ऋषिश्चिन्तां मुनिसुतस्तदा।
en: But touching the extracting of the arrow, this thought perplexed me: 'If the arrow is left alone, it pains; if extracted, death ensues.' As I was distressed, aggrieved an afflicted with sorrow, the son of the ascetic perceived my anxiety.

sa: नलश्चापि महावीर्यः संवृतो दुमवासिभिः॥ कोटीशतेन सम्प्राप्तः सहस्रेण शतेन च।
en: And the exceedingly energetic Nala came, attended with an hundred kotis, a thousand, and an hundred monkeys, living in trees.

sa: शक्यमापतितः सोढुं प्रहारो रिपुहस्ततः। शोढुमापतितः शोकः सुसूक्ष्मोऽपि न शक्यते॥
en: One can falling down bear ever beating from an enemy; but one cannot falling down bear ever so little sorrow.

sa: पृथिवीमपि काकुत्स्थ ससागरवनाचलाम्। परिवर्तयितुं शक्तः किं पुनस्तं हि रावणम्॥
en: What of the destruction of Rāvana, you are O Kākutstha. capable of uprooting the earth with oceans, forest and hills.

sa: ततः पद्मसहस्रेण वृतः शङ्कुशतेन च ॥ युवराजोऽङ्गदः प्राप्तः पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमः।
en: Then came the young prince Angada, in prowess resembling his sire, accompanied by a thousand padmas and an hundred sankhas.

sa: ततस्सं भीमधन्वानं क्रुद्धाः सर्वे निशाचराः। रामं नानाविधैः शस्त्रैरभ्यवर्षन्त दुर्जयम्॥
en: Then all the rangers of the night, waxing exceeding wroth, showered various weapons on that terrible bowman, the invincible Rāma.

sa: दिशः पर्याकुलाश्चासंस्तमसा तेन दूषिताः। चचाल च मही सर्वा सशैलवनकानना॥
en: And darkened by the gloom, all sides became bewildered. And the entire earth with her mountains, forests, and wocds, trembled.

sa: अद्यायोध्या तु नगरी राजधानी पितुर्मम। सस्त्रीपुंसा गतानस्माञ्छोचिष्यति न संशयः॥
en: Doubtless to-day the men and women of Ayodhyā, the metropolis of my father, are bewailing us retired to the forest.

sa: मङ्गलैरूपसम्पन्नो वनवासादिहागतः। वध्वाश्च मम नित्यं त्वं कामान्संवर्ध याहि भोः॥
en: May you returning from the forest and being dressed with royal robes and ornaments, satisfy the desires of my daughter-in-law.

sa: कामं खलु शरैः शक्तः सुरासुरमहोरगान्। वशे दाशरथिः कर्तुं त्वत्प्रतिज्ञामवेक्षते॥
en: Dāśarathee himself is capable of subduing the celestials, Asuras and great serpents-he is simply awaiting the fulfilment of your promise.

sa: वाग्मिनो वन्दिनश्चापि प्रहृष्टास्त्वां नरर्षभ। स्तुवन्तो नाद्य दृश्यन्ते मङ्गलैः सूतमागधाः॥
en: I do not see you, Oh best of men, eulogised with auspicious songs by the panegyrists, encomiasts and family bards.

sa: महासत्त्वो महातेजा महाबलपराक्रमः। लङ्घने प्लवने चैव भविष्यति मया समः।।१९
en: And, bed with great strength, and possessing exceeding energy, having vast vigour, he shall equal me in bound and leaping.'

sa: कृतास्त्रमकृतास्त्रं वा नैनं शक्ष्यन्ति राक्षसाः। गुप्तं कुशिकपुत्रेण ज्वलनेनामृतं यथा॥
en: Accomplished or not accomplished in weapons, the Rākṣasas cannot bear him protected by Kusika's son, like ambrosia, by flaming fire.

sa: गत्वा तु स महात्मानं रामं सत्यपराक्रमम्। अयाचद् भ्रातरं राममार्यभावपुरस्कृतः॥
en: Having come to the high-souled Rāma, with truth for his prowess, he besought his brother, with every mark of respect.

sa: उद्वीक्षमाणा भर्तारं मुखेन परिशिष्यता। मुमोच सहसा बाष्पं प्रयान्तमुपवीक्ष्य सा॥
en: Looking up to her lord with a blank countenance, she suddenly let fall tears, perceiving the destruction of the subject.

sa: ते त्वामभिगमिष्यन्ति राक्षसं योद्धमाहवे। निहत्य रावणं युद्धे ह्यानयिष्यन्ति मैथिलीम्॥
en: They will join you for battling the fiend in the field; and, slaying Ravana in fight, shall bring Mithilā's daughter.

sa: तत्र वैखानसा माषा वालखिल्या मरीचिपाः॥ आजा बभूवुधूम्राश्च संगताः परमर्षयः।
en: And it came to pass that Vaikhānasas, Māşas, Valakhilyas, Maricipas, Ayas, and Dhumras, saints of the highest order-had assembled there.

sa: अथ गद्भदशब्दस्तु विलपन् वसुधाधिपः। उवाच मृदु मन्दार्थं वचनं दीनमस्वरम्॥
en: Then with tears in his eyes, the lord of earth, lamenting, in unintelligible accents said these sad and broken words.

sa: क्व नु वत्स्यति धर्मात्मा वृक्षमूलमुपाश्रितः। सोऽत्यन्तसुखितः सूत किमशिष्यति राघवः॥
en: Where stays that righteous one, taking refuge under a tree? lapped in luxury, what, O charioteer, will Rāghava feed on?

sa: एवमादि नरश्रेष्ठो विललाप नृपात्मजः। विहङ्ग इव सारङ्गः सलिलं त्रिदशेश्वरात्॥
en: Thus bewailed that best son of a king like to the bird Sāranga soliciting water from the lord of celestials.

sa: धनदस्य सुतः श्रीमान् वानरो गन्धमादनः। विश्वकर्मा त्वजनयन्त्रलं नाम महाकपिम्।।१२
en: The Bestower of riches beget as his son the graceful ape Gandhamādana. And Viśvakarman beget that mighty monkey named Nala.

sa: इति चिन्तापरः सूतो वाजिभिः शीघ्रयायिभिः। नगरद्वारमासाद्य त्वरितः प्रविवेश ह॥
en: Having thus reflected, the charioteer drawing up to the city-gate by means of those fleetcoursing horses, speedily entered the city.

sa: तत् तु पक्वं समाज्ञाय निष्टप्तं छिन्नशोणितम्। लक्ष्मणः पुरुषव्याघ्रमथ राघवमब्रवीत्॥
en: And seeing it well scorched and hot and free from blood, Lakşmaņa spoke to that foremost of men, Rāghava, saying.

sa: तच्चास्य वचनं श्रुत्वा ज्ञातीनां शोकनाशनम्॥ उवाच परिसंहृष्टो जाम्बवान् प्लवगेश्वरः।
en: And, hearing his speech capable of removing the grief of kindred, that best of monkeys Jambavān, transported with joy, said,

sa: तद् दिव्यं राजशार्दूलः सत्कृतं माल्यभूषितम्। रामाय दर्शयामास सौमित्रिः सर्वमायुधम्॥
en: And that best of princes, the son of Sumitrā, showed Rāma those heavenly arms worshipped and well adorned with garlands...........

sa: आच्छादितास्ते वासोभिः पुष्पैर्गन्धैश्च पूजिताः। सप्तर्षयो दीप्तिमन्तो विराजन्ते यथा दिवि॥
en: And being wrapped up in cloths, and worshipped with flowers, they looked like the seven Rșis appearing in the welkin.

sa: यत्र भागीरथीं गङ्गां यमुनाभिप्रवर्तते। जग्मुस्तं देशमुद्दिश्य विगाह्य सुमहद् वनम्॥
en: Then dividing into a mighty forest, they proceeded in the direction in which the Bhāgirathi Gangå meets with the Yamunā.

sa: त्वत्सहायनिमित्तं हि प्रेषिता हरिपुङ्गवाः। आनेतुं वानरान् युद्धे सुबहून् हरिपुङ्गवान्॥
en: For rendering you assistance, the foremost monkeys have been despatched in order to summon to the conflict numerous principal monkeys.

sa: तानि चास्वाद्य तेजस्वी फलानीति स्म मन्यते। अनास्वादितपूर्वाणि वने नित्यनिवासिनाम्॥
en: And tasting those things, the glorious one took them for fruits, never tasted before by the dwellers of the forest.

sa: सुखी बत सुभार्यश्च भरतः केकयीसुतः। मुदितान् कोसलानेको यो भोक्ष्यत्यधिराजवत्॥
en: Ah! Kaikeyi's son Bharata with his wife is really happy, he that enjoys the sole sovereignty of the delighted Kosalas.

sa: घृताच्यां किल संसक्तो दश वर्षाणि लक्ष्मण। अहोऽमन्यत धर्मात्मा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः॥ स हि प्राप्तं न जानीते कालं कालविदां वरः। विश्वामित्रो महातेजाः किं पुनर्यः पृथगजनः॥
en: Attached to Ghrtāci, O Laksmana, the pious and mighty ascetic, Viśvāmitra looked upon ten years as one day; and that best of those conversant with time, Viśvāmitra of mighty energy, did not perceive that the time (for doing a certain act) had arrived. What is to be said of other people?

sa: साहाय्यं वानरेन्द्रस्य यदि नाहं हनूमतः। करिष्यामि भविष्यामि सर्ववाच्यो विवक्षताम्॥
en: He said himself, ‘Truly shall I be blamed of all persons if I do not assist this lord of monkeys-Hanumān.'

sa: रामाय तु यथातत्वं जटायो हरणं मम। लक्ष्मणाय च तत्सर्वमाख्यातव्यमशेषतः॥
en: Do you relate to Rāma and to Lakşmaņa everything about my being carried away from the beginning to the end.

sa: स महात्मा मुहूर्तेन पर्वतः सलिलावृतः। दर्शयामास शृङ्गाणि सागरेण नियोजितः॥
en: Being thus commanded by the Ocean, the great mountain, covered on all sides with water, immediately brought forth his peaks.

sa: निवर्त्यमानो रामेण सुमन्त्रः प्रतिबोधितः। तत्सर्वं वचनं श्रुत्वा स्नेहात् काकुत्स्थमब्रवीत्॥
en: Told by Rāma to go back and instructed in this wise, Sumantra having heard everything, addressed Kākutstha from affection, saying.

sa: शबरीदर्शनं चैव फलमूलाशनं तथा। प्रलापं चैव पम्पाया हनूमद्दर्शनं तथा॥
en: Rāma's interview with Śabarī, and his subsistence there on fruits and roots; Rāma's lamentations at Pampā, and meeting with Hanumān.

sa: दर्शनं चाप्यगस्त्यस्य धनुषो ग्रहणं तथा। शूर्पणख्याश्च संवाद विरूपकरणं तथा॥
en: And Rāma's interview with Agastya, and his obtaining the bow from him; and the dialogue of Śūrpanakha and her disfigurement.

sa: स तु रामस्य वचनं निशम्य प्रतिगृह्य च। स्थपतिस्तूर्णमाहूय सचिवानिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing of Rāma's speech and accepting it, that lord of the Nişādas speedily summoning his counsellors spoke to them saying.

sa: यावत् स्थास्यन्ति गिरयः सरितश्च महीतले॥ तावद् रामायणकथा लोकेषु प्रचरिष्यति।
en: As long as the mountains and the seas exist on earth, the history of Rāmāyaṇa will remain prevalent among men.
